fancymenu.placeholders.file_md5.desc:
Returns the MD5 hash of a local file.
Only supports local files, not URLs.
Returns an empty string if the file doesn't exist or cannot be read.

You can target the default '.minecraft'
directory by starting the file path with '.minecraft/'.
fancymenu.placeholders.file_size.desc:
Returns the size of a local file in bytes.
Only supports local files, not URLs.
Returns 0 if the file doesn't exist or cannot be read.

You can target the default '.minecraft'
directory by starting the file path with '.minecraft/'.
fancymenu.placeholders.file_text.desc:
Reads text from a local file or remote URL and returns it.
Supports reading entire content or only the last few lines.

Content is cached to improve performance:
- Local files: Re-read every 1 second
- URLs: Re-read every 10 seconds

Required values:
- path_or_url: The file path or URL to read from
  Local files: Use relative paths (e.g. 'config/myfile.txt')
  Remote files: Use HTTP/HTTPS URLs (e.g. 'https://example.com/data.txt')
  
The file path can start with '.minecraft/' to target the default .minecraft directory.

Optional values:
- mode: How to read the content (default: 'all')
  Options: 'all' (entire content), 'last' (last X lines)
- separator: Text between lines when joining (default: '\n')
  Common options: '\n' (newline), ' | ', ', ', ' '
- last_lines: Number of lines to return in 'last' mode (default: 1)
  Only used when mode is 'last'

Note: When mode is 'last' with last_lines set to 1,
the single line is returned without any separator.

Returns empty string if source is not cached yet, doesn't exist,
cannot be read, or if there's no internet connection for URLs.
fancymenu.placeholders.get_variable.desc:
Gets the text content of a stored variable.
This is only to get variables stored via FancyMenu
and will not work for mod or Vanilla variables.

Just replace 'some_variable' with the actual variable name.
fancymenu.placeholders.guiheight.desc: The height of the current screen.
fancymenu.placeholders.guiwidth.desc: The width of the current screen.
fancymenu.placeholders.json.desc:
Parse JSON and get a value from it.

The 'source' value accepts:
- Direct JSON content (e.g. {"key":"value"})
- Path to a local JSON file
- URL to a remote JSON file

Replace '$.some.json.path' with the JSON path to the value you want to get.

Go to json.fancymenu.net to learn more about JSON paths.
fancymenu.placeholders.jvm_cpu_usage.des: Gets the current CPU usage of the Java Virtual Machine.
fancymenu.placeholders.jvm_name.desc: The name of the Java Virtual Machine.
fancymenu.placeholders.last_death_messag: Shows the latest death message you received. Set "as_json_component" to true to return the serialized text component instead of plain text.
fancymenu.placeholders.last_world_server:
Returns the last world or server the player joined.
You can control via the 'type' value if the placeholder
should return both servers and worlds or only one of them.

Types: both, world, server

The 'full_world_path' value controls if the full path or
only the name of the world (not server) should get returned.
Setting this to 'false' will only return the world name.
fancymenu.placeholders.loaded_mods.desc:
Gets the active mods count.
This doesn't include disabled mods.
fancymenu.placeholders.loader_name.desc: Gets the name of the mod loader (Forge, Fabric, etc.).
fancymenu.placeholders.loader_version.de: Gets the version of the mod loader (Forge, Fabric, etc.).
fancymenu.placeholders.local.desc:
Localizes a text by the given key.

Just replace 'localization.key' in the
placeholder with a localization key.

Supports Minecraft's localization keys and custom ones!

Check docs.fancymenu.net for how to add localizations!
fancymenu.placeholders.lowercase_text.de:
Converts the input text to lowercase letters.

Example:
Input: HELLO WORLD
Output: hello world
fancymenu.placeholders.math_ceil.desc:
Returns the smallest integer greater than or equal to the given number.
For example, ceil(3.14) = 4 and ceil(-3.14) = -3.
fancymenu.placeholders.math_cos.desc: Returns the trigonometric cosine of an angle.
fancymenu.placeholders.math_cosh.desc: Returns the hyperbolic cosine of a double value.
fancymenu.placeholders.math_floor.desc:
Returns the largest integer less than or equal to the given number.
For example, floor(3.14) = 3 and floor(-3.14) = -4.
fancymenu.placeholders.math_round.desc:
Rounds a number.
Set the optional 'decimals' value to control the decimal place (use 0 or -1 round to an integer).
Example 1: num=3.14159 & decimals=2 -> 3.14.
Example 2: num=3.14159 & decimals=0 -> 3.
fancymenu.placeholders.math_sign.desc:
Returns:
 1 if the number is positive
-1 if the number is negative
 0 if the number is zero
fancymenu.placeholders.math_sin.desc: Returns the trigonometric sine of an angle.
fancymenu.placeholders.math_sinh.desc: Returns the hyperbolic sine of a double value.
fancymenu.placeholders.math_tan.desc: Returns the trigonometric tangent of an angle.
fancymenu.placeholders.math_tanh.desc: Returns the hyperbolic tangent of a double value.
fancymenu.placeholders.max_number.desc: Returns the greater of two numbers.
fancymenu.placeholders.min_number.desc: Returns the smaller of two numbers.
fancymenu.placeholders.minecraft_option_:
Gets the current value of a Minecraft option.
For a list of valid option names, take a look at
the 'options.txt' file of your Minecraft instance.
fancymenu.placeholders.modversion.desc:
Gets the version of a mod by its mod ID.

Just replace 'some_mod_id' in the placeholder
with an existing mod ID.
fancymenu.placeholders.mouseposx.desc:
Gets the mouse X position.

Always returns 10 while in the editor,
so you can still edit the element
without it following your mouse when
using it for advanced sizing/positioning.
fancymenu.placeholders.mouseposy.desc:
Gets the mouse Y position.

Always returns 10 while in the editor,
so you can still edit the element
without it following your mouse when
using it for advanced sizing/positioning.
fancymenu.placeholders.nbt_data_get.clie:
Reads NBT directly from the client's world state.
Supports entity selectors with type/name/tag/limit/sort/distance/x/y/z/dx/dy/dz options,
plus absolute or relative block positions, returning value,
string, or SNBT formats entirely client-side.
fancymenu.placeholders.nbt_data_get.desc:
Gets NBT data from entities and blocks (similar to '/data get' command).
Returns the value at the specified NBT path.

TIP: Use the '/data get' command in-game without setting a path
to easily get all available NBT paths for an entity or block!

Required values:
- source_type: The data source type ('entity' or 'block')
- nbt_path: The NBT path to query (e.g. 'foodLevel', 'Pos[0]', 'Inventory[0].id')

Conditional values:
- entity_selector: Entity selector when source_type is 'entity'
  Supports: @s (self), @p (nearest player), @e (nearest entity),
  UUID, or entity name
- block_pos: Block position when source_type is 'block'
  Format: 'x y z' (e.g. '100 64 -200')

Optional values:
- scale: Scale factor for numeric values (default: 1.0)
- return_type: How to return the data (default: 'value')
  Options: 'value' (numeric/size), 'string' (text value),
  'snbt' (formatted NBT), 'json' (JSON format)

Returns empty string if data cannot be accessed or path is invalid.
fancymenu.placeholders.nbt_data_get.serv:
Requires FancyMenu on the server.

Fetches live NBT data from the server, mirroring every target supported by '/data get'.
Returns an empty value until the server response arrives.

The placeholder works exactly like the '/data get' command, so everything that should be possible with the command should also be possible with the placeholder.

Supported source_type values:
- entity: Full selector syntax (scores, advancements, predicates, rotation, gamemode, etc.)
- block: Absolute, relative (~) or local (^) coordinates like the vanilla command
- storage: Command storage identifiers (namespace:key)

Optional arguments:
- nbt_path: Same path rules as '/data get'
- scale: Multiplies numeric results (default 1.0)
- return_type: 'value', 'string', 'snbt', or 'json'

Responses are cached for 100ms to avoid spamming the server.
fancymenu.placeholders.negate_number.des:
Returns the negation of the given number.
If the given number is negative, the given number is returned.
fancymenu.placeholders.number_base_conve:
Converts a number between bases (supports decimals).
Values: input, from_base (2-36), to_base (2-36).
Up to 16 fractional digits are generated in the target base.
Example: input=67, from_base=10, to_base=2 -> 1000011.
fancymenu.placeholders.os.desc: The name of the Operating System.
fancymenu.placeholders.os_cpu_usage.desc: Gets the current CPU usage of the Operating System.
fancymenu.placeholders.pi.desc: Returns the double value that is closer than any other to pi, the ratio of the circumference of a circle to its diameter.
fancymenu.placeholders.player_has_tag.de:
Checks if a specific player has a specific tag. Returns 'true' or 'false'.

These are the tags that you add via the '/tag' command.
Returns a list of all tags for a specific player, separated by the specified separator.

These are the tags that you add via the '/tag' command.
fancymenu.placeholders.player_team.desc:
Returns the current team of the given player
or an empty value if the player has no team.
fancymenu.placeholders.random_number.des:
Returns a random number in the specified range.
Returns a different number every tick,
so it's recommended to use the
placeholder in combination with
a variable or something else to
control the refresh rate.
fancymenu.placeholders.randomtext.desc:
Picks a random line from a TXT file, URL or direct plain text.

Supports local files, remote URLs and plain text as "source":
- Local files: Use relative paths (e.g. '/config/fancymenu/assets/tips.txt')
- Remote files: Use HTTP/HTTPS URLs (e.g. 'https://example.com/tips.txt')
- Plain text: Input direct plain text. Separate lines with "\n".

Content is automatically reloaded every 30 seconds to pick up changes.

The 'interval' parameter controls how often a new random line is selected
from the loaded content (in seconds).

An interval of 0 will make it pick a line only once per session.

For local files, just replace '<file_name.txt>' with your file path.
Local files HAVE to be placed in FancyMenu's ASSETS folder!
fancymenu.placeholders.replace_text.desc:
Replaces text in a string using either literal text or regular expressions (regex).
Supports both single replacement and replace-all operations.

Required values:
- text: The input text to perform replacements on
- search: The text or regex pattern to search for

Optional values:
- replacement: The replacement text (default: empty string)
- use_regex: Set to 'true' to use regex patterns (default: 'false')
- replace_all: Set to 'true' to replace all occurrences, otherwise only first occurrence (default: 'true')

When using regex, you can use capture groups like $1, $2, etc.
fancymenu.placeholders.scoreboard.displa:
Returns the name of the objective displayed in a specific slot.
Returns an empty value if no objective is assigned to that slot.

Required values:
- slot: The display slot to check
  Valid slots: sidebar, list, below_name, or team color slots
  (e.g., sidebar.team.red, sidebar.team.blue)
fancymenu.placeholders.scoreboard.has_sc:
Checks if a player has a score for a specific objective.
Returns 'true' if the player has a score, 'false' otherwise.

Required values:
- player: The player name to check
- objective: The objective name to check
fancymenu.placeholders.scoreboard.object:
Returns the total number of objectives in the scoreboard.
Returns '0' if no objectives exist.

Returns the criteria type of an objective.
Common criteria: dummy, trigger, deathCount, playerKillCount,
totalKillCount, health, food, air, armor, xp, level, etc.

Required values:
- objective: The objective name to check

Returns the display name of an objective.
Can return as plain text or JSON format for advanced formatting.

Required values:
- objective: The objective name

Optional values:
- as_json: Set to 'true' to get JSON format (default: 'false')

Returns how an objective's scores are displayed.
Possible values: 'integer' (normal numbers) or 'hearts' (heart icons).

Required values:
- objective: The objective name to check

Returns a list of all objectives in the scoreboard.
Each objective name is separated by the specified separator.

Optional values:
- separator: The text to separate objectives (default: ', ')
fancymenu.placeholders.scoreboard.player:
Returns a formatted list of all scores for a specific player.
Use %%objective%% and %%score%% in the format to customize output.

Required values:
- player: The player name to list scores for

Optional values:
- separator: Text between each score entry (default: ', ')
- format: How to format each entry (default: '%%objective%%: %%score%%')
Returns the score value of a player for a specific objective.
Returns an empty value if the player has no score for that objective.

Required values:
- player: The player name to check
- objective: The objective name to get the score from
fancymenu.placeholders.scoreboard.tracke:
Returns a list of all players tracked by the scoreboard.
Players who have any score in any objective will be listed.

Optional values:
- separator: The text to separate player names (default: ', ')
fancymenu.placeholders.screen_identifier: Returns the identifier of the screen that is currently open. Returns an empty value if no screen is open.
fancymenu.placeholders.servermotd.desc:
Gets the MOTD of a server.
Just replace 'someserver.com:25565'
with the actual server IP
and '1' with the MOTD line.
MOTDs only have 2 lines, so
the only valid line values are
'1' and '2'.
fancymenu.placeholders.serverping.desc:
Gets the ping to a server.

Just replace 'someserver.com:25565' in the
placeholder with a valid server IP.
fancymenu.placeholders.serverplayercount:
Gets the player count of a server.

Just replace 'someserver.com:25565' in the
placeholder with a valid server IP.
fancymenu.placeholders.serverstatus.desc:
Gets the status (online/offline) of a server.

Just replace 'someserver.com:25565' in the
placeholder with a valid server IP.
fancymenu.placeholders.serverversion.des:
Gets the MC version of a server.

Just replace 'someserver.com:25565' in the
placeholder with a valid server IP.
fancymenu.placeholders.split_text.desc:
Splits a text at a specific character or regex.

input = The text to split.
regex = The character or regex for where to split the text.
max_parts = The max parts the text should get split into. Setting this to -1 disables the limit.
split_index = The part that should get returned after splitting. Starts at 0.
fancymenu.placeholders.stringify.desc:
Stringifies a text by escaping all
syntax characters ( " { } ).

This is useful when nesting other
placeholders as value. If the
replaced nested placeholder could
contain syntax characters that aren't
part of another placeholder, you need
to escape them.

Placeholders in the value will be
replaced first, so you don't need
to worry about them getting stringified.
fancymenu.placeholders.switch_case.desc:
Matches a value against multiple cases and returns the corresponding result.
Format: value to match, case pairs (value:result) separated by commas, optional default case.
Example: value="1", cases="1:first,2:second", default="none"
fancymenu.placeholders.text_char_count.d: Returns the character count of the given text.
fancymenu.placeholders.text_width.desc:
Returns the width in pixels of the given text.
Useful for calculating element positions or sizes based on text width.
fancymenu.placeholders.totalmods.desc:
Gets the total mods count.
This includes disabled mods.
fancymenu.placeholders.trim_text.desc:
Removes all leading and trailing spaces of the
given text, but not spaces within the text.
fancymenu.placeholders.unix_time.desc:
The current time in milliseconds, measured by the time
that has elapsed since 00:00:00 UTC on 1 January 1970.
fancymenu.placeholders.uppercase_text.de:
Converts the input text to uppercase letters.

Example:
Input: Hello World
Output: HELLO WORLD
fancymenu.placeholders.uptime_seconds.de: Returns the time since the game launched in seconds or, if "output_as_millis" is true, in milliseconds.
fancymenu.placeholders.vanillabuttonlabe:
Get the label/text of a Vanilla widget/button.

Replace 'some.menu.identifier:505280' with
the correct widget locator
of the target widget.

The widget locator points to a specific
widget in a specific screen.

You can right-click widgets
in the editor to copy their locator.
fancymenu.placeholders.video_background_:
Returns the total duration of a Video menu background in MM:SS format (e.g. '03:45') by its identifier.
Returns '00:00' if the background is not ready yet or not video is set.

To get the identifier of a background, right-click the
editor background and click on 'Copy Background Identifier'.

Returns the paused state of a Video menu background by its identifier.
Returns 'true' when the element is paused, otherwise returns 'false'.

To get the identifier of a background, right-click the
editor background and click on 'Copy Background Identifier'.

Returns either the current play time of a Video menu background
(MM:SS format) or the play progress percentage (0-100).
Returns '00:00' or '0' if the element is not ready yet or no video is set.

Required values:
- background_identifier: The ID of the Video background
- show_percentage: Set to 'true' to show percentage instead of time

To get the identifier of a background, right-click the
editor background and click on 'Copy Background Identifier'.

Returns the volume of a Video menu background by its identifier.
The volume is a decimal between 0.0 (0%%) and 1.0 (100%%).

To get the identifier of a background, right-click the
editor background and click on 'Copy Background Identifier'.
fancymenu.placeholders.video_element_dur:
Returns the total duration of a Video element in MM:SS format (e.g. '03:45').
Returns '00:00' if the element is not ready yet or not video is set.

Required values:
- element_identifier: The ID of the Video element to get the duration from
fancymenu.placeholders.video_element_pla:
Returns either the current play time of a Video element
(MM:SS format) or the play progress percentage (0-100).
Returns '00:00' or '0' if the element is not ready yet or no video is set.

Required values:
- element_identifier: The ID of the Video element
- show_percentage: Set to 'true' to show percentage instead of time
fancymenu.placeholders.video_element_vol:
Returns the volume of a Video element.
The volume is a decimal between 0.0 (0%%) and 1.0 (100%%).
fancymenu.placeholders.video_paused_stat:
Returns the paused state of a Video element.
Returns 'true' when the element is paused, otherwise returns 'false'.
fancymenu.placeholders.webtext.desc:
Gets the first line of
plain text content from a website.

Replace 'http://somewebsite.com/textfile.txt'
with the link to the page you
want to get the text from.
fancymenu.placeholders.world.active_effe:
Returns the key of the active effect for the given index.
Takes a zero-based index for the effect to get.
The index of the first effect is 0.
Returns an empty value when not in a world or
when no active effect exists for the given index.
fancymenu.placeholders.world.active_hotb:
Returns the currently selected hotbar slot as number.
Returns '0' if no world is loaded.
Possible Values: 0-8
Returns the amount of currently active bosses.
Returns '0' when not in a world or when no boss is active.
fancymenu.placeholders.world.boss_name.d:
Returns the name of an active boss.
Takes a zero-based index for the boss you want to get the name of.
The first boss has and index of 0.
Also takes a boolean (true/false) if the name should be returned as JSON.
Returns an empty value when not in a world or no boss with the given index is active.
fancymenu.placeholders.world.current_bos:
Returns the current health of an active boss in percent.
Takes a zero-based index for the boss you want to get the health of.
The first boss has and index of 0.
Returns '0' when not in a world or no boss with the given index is active.
Possible Values: 0-100
fancymenu.placeholders.world.current_mou:
Returns the current health of the player's mount.
Returns '0.0' when not in a world or not riding an entity with health.

Returns the current health of the player's mount in percent.
Returns '0' when not in a world or not riding an entity with health.
Possible Values: 0-100

Returns the current jump meter value of the player's mount in percent.
Returns '0' when not in a world or not riding an entity that can jump.
Possible Values: 0-100
fancymenu.placeholders.world.current_pla: Current Player Absorption Health

Returns the current absorption health of the player.
Returns '0.0' when not in a world.
Current Player Absorption Health (Percent)

Returns the current absorption health of the player in percent.
Returns '0' when not in a world.
Possible Values: 0-100
Current Player Armor

Returns the current armor of the player.
Returns '0.0' when not in a world.
Current Player Armor (Percent)

Returns the current armor of the player in percent.
Returns '0' when not in a world.
Possible Values: 0-100
Player Experience Progress (Percent)

Returns the experience progress of the player in percent.
This is the basically the experience bar value.
Returns '0' when not in a world.
Possible Values: 0-100
Current Player Experience

Returns the current total experience of the player.
This is not the player level.
Returns '0.0' when not in a world.
Current Player Health

Returns the current health of the player.
Returns '0.0' when not in a world.
Current Player Health (Percent)

Returns the current health of the player in percent.
Returns '0' when not in a world.
Possible Values: 0-100
Current Player Food Level

Returns the current food level of the player.
Returns '0.0' when not in a world.
Current Player Food Level (Percent)

Returns the current food level of the player in percent.
Returns '0' when not in a world.
Possible Values: 0-100
Current Player Level

Returns the current level of the player.
Returns '0' when not in a world.
Current Player Oxygen Level

Returns the current oxygen level of the player.
Returns '0.0' when not in a world.
Current Player Oxygen Level (Percent)

Returns the current oxygen level of the player in percent.
Returns '0' when not in a world.
Possible Values: 0-100
fancymenu.placeholders.world.current_ser:
Returns the IP of the current server.
Returns an empty value when the player is not on a server.
fancymenu.placeholders.world.current_tit:
Returns the currently active HUD title or subtitle.
Takes a boolean (true/false) if it should return the subtitle.
Also takes a boolean (true/false) if it should return the title as JSON.
Returns an empty value if not in a world or no title/subtitle is active.
Returns the current world's difficulty.
Returns empty value if no world is loaded.
Possible Values: peaceful, easy, normal, hard
fancymenu.placeholders.world.effects_cou:
Returns the amount of currently active effects.
Returns '0' when not in a world or when no effect is active.
fancymenu.placeholders.world.level_save_:
Returns the complete level data of a specific world save as single-line JSON.

Values:
level_name = The exact name of the world save to get data for.

Returns a list of all available local world save names.

Values:
separator = The separator text between world names. Default is ', '.
fancymenu.placeholders.world.max_mount_h:
Returns the max health of the player's mount.
Returns '0.0' when not in a world or not riding an entity with health.
fancymenu.placeholders.world.max_player_:
Returns the max absorption health of the player.
Returns '0.0' when not in a world.

Returns the max armor of the player.
Returns '0.0' when not in a world.

Returns the max health of the player.
Returns '0.0' when not in a world.

Returns the max food level of the player.
Returns '0.0' when not in a world.

Returns the max oxygen level of the player.
Returns '0.0' when not in a world.
fancymenu.placeholders.world.player_atta:
Returns the current attack strength of the player.
Returns '0' when not in a world.
Possible Values: 0-100
fancymenu.placeholders.world.player_game:
Returns the current game mode of the player.
Returns an empty value when not in a world.
Possible Values: survival, creative, adventure, spectator
fancymenu.placeholders.world.player_view:
Returns the player's view direction.
Returns an empty value when not in a world.
Possible Values: north, east, south, west
fancymenu.placeholders.world.player_x_co:
Returns the X coordinate of the player.
Returns '0' when not in a world.
fancymenu.placeholders.world.player_y_co:
Returns the Y coordinate of the player.
Returns '0' when not in a world.
fancymenu.placeholders.world.player_z_co:
Returns the Z coordinate of the player.
Returns '0' when not in a world.
fancymenu.placeholders.world.players_lis:
Returns a list of all players currently in the world.
Player names are sorted alphabetically.

Optional values:
- separator: The text to separate player names (default: ', ')
fancymenu.placeholders.world.slot_item.d:
Returns the key of the item in the given inventory slot.
Takes a slot number to point to an inventory slot.
Returns an empty value when not in a world.
fancymenu.placeholders.world.world_day_t:
The current world's day time.
This is the time within a day.
Returns '0' if no world is loaded.

The current world's day time hour.
This is the time within a day.
Returns '0' if no world is loaded.

The current world's day time minute within the current hour.
This is the time within a day.
Returns '0' if no world is loaded.
fancymenu.placeholders.world.world_game_:
The current world's game time.
This is the total game time, not the day time.
Returns '0' if no world is loaded.
fancymenu.placeholders.world_load_progre:
Reflects the world loading progress
while in a Progress Screen.
Can be used to make loading bars, etc.

Returns a percentage integer between 0 and 100.
fancymenu.requirements.async.cant_run_as:
Failed to check FancyMenu requirement!

You tried to asynchronously use an requirement that only works on the game thread.
The requirement is probably part of a Ticker element that runs in Async mode.

Requirement Name: %s
fancymenu.requirements.elements.loading_:
Manage this element's loading requirements.

Loading requirements can be used to
specify under which circumstances
an element should load/be visible.
fancymenu.requirements.file_exists.desc:
Check if a file/folder exists.

You can target the default '.minecraft' directory by starting the file path with '.minecraft/'.
fancymenu.requirements.fullscreen.desc: Check if the game window is fullscreen.
fancymenu.requirements.gamemode.is_adven:
Check if the player is
currently in adventure mode.
fancymenu.requirements.gamemode.is_creat:
Check if the player is
currently in creative mode.
fancymenu.requirements.gamemode.is_spect:
Check if the player is
currently in spectator mode.
fancymenu.requirements.gamemode.is_survi:
Check if the player is
currently in survival mode.
fancymenu.requirements.guiscale.desc:
Check if the current GUI scale is X.

You can check for bigger than ('>'),
smaller than ('<') and equals X.

For example, if you want to check
if the scale is smaller than 3.20,
type '<3.20' (without the '').
To check if the scale is equal to 1.0,
just type '1.0' (without the '').
When checking if the scale is bigger than 2.20,
type '>2.20' (without the '').
fancymenu.requirements.is_any_button_hov:
Checks if ANY button is hovered.
Includes Vanilla and custom buttons.
fancymenu.requirements.is_any_element_ho:
Checks if ANY element is hovered.
This can be anything, not just buttons.
fancymenu.requirements.is_any_screen_ope:
Returns true if any screen is open.
For example, this will return false if the user is walking around in a world, because then there's no screen open.
It will return true if the Inventory or Pause screen is open.
Check if a button is active (clickable).
Use its element ID to identify it.

You can get the ID of an element
by right-clicking it in the editor.
fancymenu.requirements.is_element_focuse:
Checks if an element is focused in its parent screen.
Some elements get focused when you interact with them, like buttons or sliders.
For buttons and sliders you will then see an outline, like they are hovered, but they can also get focused when using the arrow keys or the Tab key to navigate in screens.

This is useful, because in case of arrow or Tab key navigation, elements will not be seen as 'hovered', so the 'Is Element Hovered' requirement would not return true then.

It is important to note that not every type of element can be focused. Most of the time it's only buttons and sliders.
fancymenu.requirements.is_element_hovere:
Check if an element is hovered.
Use its element ID to identify it.

You can get the ID of an element
by right-clicking it in the editor.
fancymenu.requirements.is_internet_conne: Returns true when there is a working internet connection available.
fancymenu.requirements.is_key_pressed.de: Checks if a keyboard key is pressed.
fancymenu.requirements.is_key_pressed.sc: Press any key now to select it..
fancymenu.requirements.is_layout_enabled: Check if a layout is enabled.
fancymenu.requirements.is_mcef_loaded.de:
Checks if the MCEF mod is loaded.

This mod is needed for the Browser element and for all
video-related features like the Video element and menu background.
fancymenu.requirements.is_menu_title.des:
Checks for a specific screen title.
Screen titles are the names of GUIs you can see in some GUIs like
the Options or Pause screen.
fancymenu.requirements.is_menu_title.val: Plain Text Title or Localization Key
fancymenu.requirements.is_mod_loaded.des:
Check if a specific mod is loaded.

You can find the IDs of mods in the 'Mods' menu.
This menu is available by default
on Forge. On Fabric, download
the 'Mod Menu' mod.
fancymenu.requirements.is_number.desc:
Check if a number matches another.

Compare Modes:
equals, bigger-than, smaller-than,
bigger-than-or-equals,

twilightforest.config.hollow_hill_stalac:
Defines custom stalactites generated in hollow hills.
Format is \"modid:block<:meta> size max_Length min_Height weight\", where the properties are:
Size - the maximum length of the stalactite relative to the space between hill floor and ceiling,
Max length - maximum length of a stalactite in blocks,
Min height - minimum space between the hill floor and the stalactite to let it generate,
Weight - how often it generates.

For example: \"minecraft:iron_ore 0.7 8 1 24\" would add a stalactite equal to the default iron ore stalactite.
twilightforest.config.large_hill.tooltip: Blocks generating as stalactites in large hills only.
twilightforest.config.medium_hill.toolti: Blocks generating as stalactites in medium and large hills.
twilightforest.config.small_hill.tooltip: Blocks generating as stalactites in all hills.
twilightforest.config.stalactite_config_: If true, default stalactites and stalactites defined by other mods will not be used.
twilightforest.config.silent_cicadas.too: Make cicadas silent for those having sound library problems, or otherwise finding them annoying.
twilightforest.config.silent_cicadas_on_: Make cicadas silent when sitting on your head. If the above option is already true, this won't have any effect.
twilightforest.config.first_person_effec: Controls whether various effects from the mod are rendered while in first-person view. Turn this off if you find them distracting.
twilightforest.config.origin_dimension.t: The dimension you can always travel to the Twilight Forest from, as well as the dimension you will return to. Defaults to the overworld.
twilightforest.config.portals_in_other_d: Allow portals to the Twilight Forest to be made outside of the 'origin' dimension. May be considered an exploit.
twilightforest.config.admin_portals.tool: Allow portals only for admins (Operators). This severely reduces the range in which the mod usually scans for valid portal conditions, and it scans near ops only.
twilightforest.config.portals.tooltip: Disable Twilight Forest portal creation entirely. Provided for server operators looking to restrict action to the dimension.
twilightforest.config.portal_lighting.to: Set this true if you want the lightning that zaps the portal to not set things on fire. For those who don't like fun.
twilightforest.config.portal_return: Should Portals generate as a two-way portal
twilightforest.config.portal_return.tool: If false, the return portal will require the activation item.
twilightforest.config.check_portal_desti:
Determines if new portals should be pre-checked for safety. If enabled, portals will fail to form rather than redirect to a safe alternate destination.
_Note that enabling this also reduces the rate at which portal formation checks are performed.
twilightforest.config.max_portal_size.to: The max amount of water spaces the mod will check for when creating a portal. Very high numbers may cause issues.
twilightforest.config.portal_unlocked_by: Use a valid advancement resource location as a string. For example, using the string "minecraft:story/mine_diamond" will lock the portal behind the "Diamonds!" advancement. Invalid/Empty Advancement resource IDs will leave the portal entirely unlocked.
twilightforest.config.uncrafting.tooltip: Disable the uncrafting function of the uncrafting table. Recommended as a last resort if there's too many things to change about its behavior.
twilightforest.config.uncrafting_recipes: Disable Uncrafting Recipes in Uncrafting Table

If you don't want to disable uncrafting altogether, and would rather disable certain recipes, this is for you.
To add a recipe, add the mod id followed by the name of the recipe. You can check this in things like JEI.
Example: "twilightforest:firefly_particle_spawner" will disable uncrafting the particle spawner into a firefly jar, firefly, and poppy.
If an item has multiple crafting recipes and you wish to disable them all, add the item to the "twilightforest:banned_uncraftables" item tag.
If you have a problematic ingredient, like infested towerwood for example, add the item to the "twilightforest:banned_uncrafting_ingredients" item tag.
twilightforest.config.uncrafting_xp_cost:
Setting this to true will make it so you dont have to pay XP to uncraft stuff. This will only affect uncrafting.
If you want to disable the xp cost for repairing and recrafting, see the below option.
Setting this to true will make it so you dont have to pay XP to repair and recraft stuff in the uncrafting table. This wont affect uncrafting cost.
If youre confused about what repairing and recrafting are, you can read about them here: http://benimatic.com/tfwiki/index.php?title=Uncrafting_Table
If you want to disable the xp cost for uncrafting, see the above option.

Input a valid mod id to disable all uncrafting recipes from that mod.
Example: "twilightforest" will disable all uncrafting recipes from this mod.

twilightforest.book.author: a forgotten explorer
twilightforest.book.lichtower.1:
[[An explorer's notebook, gnawed on by monsters]]

I have begun examining the strange aura surrounding this tower. The bricks of the tower are protected by a curse, stronger than any I've seen before. The magic from the curse
twilightforest.book.lichtower.2:
is boiling off into the surrounding area.

In my homeland I would have many options for dealing with this magic, but here my supplies are limited. I shall have to research...
twilightforest.book.lichtower.3:
[[Many entries later]]

A breakthrough! In my journeys I sighted a huge snake-like monster in a decorated courtyard. Nearby, I picked up a worn down, discarded green scale.

The magic in the scale seems to have the
twilightforest.book.lichtower.4: curse-breaking properties I need, but the magic is too dim. I may need to acquire a fresher specimen, directly from the creature.
twilightforest.book.labyrinth.1:
[[An explorer's notebook, written on waterproof paper]]

The mosquitoes in this swamp are vexing, but strange. The vast majority of them seem to have no natural source, nor do they seem to have a role in the local ecology. I have begun to
twilightforest.book.labyrinth.2:
suspect that they are some kind of magical curse.

[[Next entry]]

Now that I have encountered a protection spell on the ruined labyrinth here, I consider my suspicions confirmed. Both the protection
twilightforest.book.labyrinth.3:
spell and the mosquitoes are a curse. This curse seems to have a different source from the others I have encountered. I will have to research further...

[[Next entry]]

The curse seems to
twilightforest.book.labyrinth.4:
be of a type too powerful for one being alone to produce. Several wizards working in combination would be necessary.

If one of the wizards stopped contributing, the whole of the curse over the entire swamp would fall. Strangely,
twilightforest.book.labyrinth.5: my divinations do not show signs of any nearby living wizards. I did see something interesting in one of the nearby pointy-roofed towers though...
twilightforest.book.hydralair.1:
[[An explorer's notebook, written on fireproof paper]]

Fire is a trivial obstacle for a master explorer such as myself. I have traversed seas of fire, and swam through oceans of lava. The burning air here is an interesting variation,
twilightforest.book.hydralair.2:
but ultimately no hindrance.

What does stop me though is that I have encountered another protection spell, this time surrounding a mighty creature that must be king of this fire swamp. This is not the first protection spell I have
twilightforest.book.hydralair.3:
encountered, and I am beginning to unravel the mysteries of how they work.

If this spell is like the others, it will be sustained by a powerful creature nearby. Surrounding the fire swamp are several wet swamps, and under those
twilightforest.book.hydralair.4: swamps are labyrinths full of minotaurs. The logical choice to bind such a spell to would be some sort of powerful minotaur, different in some way from the others that surround it...
twilightforest.book.tfstronghold.1:
[[An explorer's notebook, written on faintly glowing paper]]

The tendrils of darkness surrounding this area are just a manifestation of a protective spell over the entire dark forest. The spell causes blindness, which is quite vexing. I have
twilightforest.book.tfstronghold.2:
seen several interesting things in the area and would like to keep exploring.

[[Next entry]]

I have found ruins in the dark forest. They belong to a stronghold, of a type usually inhabited by knights. Rather than
twilightforest.book.tfstronghold.3:
knights though, this stronghold is full of goblins. They wear knightly armor, but their behavior is most un-knightly.

[[Next entry]]

Deep in the ruins, I have found a pedestal. The pedestal seems to be of a type that
twilightforest.book.tfstronghold.4:
knights would place trophies on to prove their strength.
\Obtaining a powerful scepter would seem to weaken the curse on the dark forest, and placing a trophy associated with a powerful creature on the pedestal would likely grant access into the
twilightforest.book.darktower.1:
[[An explorer's notebook that seems to have survived an explosion]]

This tower clearly has mechanisms that are not responding to me. Their magic almost yearns to acknowledge my touch, but it cannot. It is if the devices of the tower are being
twilightforest.book.darktower.2:
suppressed by a powerful group of beings nearby.

[[Next entry]]

The magic seems to emanate from deep within the strongholds nearby. It can't come from the goblins, as their magic is charming, but unfocused. There
twilightforest.book.darktower.3:
must still be some force still active in the strongholds.

[[Next entry]]

My analysis indicates that it comes from several sources, operating as a group. I will head back to the stronghold after I resupply...
twilightforest.book.yeticave.1:
[[An explorer's notebook, covered in frost]]

The blizzard surrounding these snowy lands is unceasing. This is no ordinary snowfall--this is a magical phenomenon. I will have to conduct experiments to find
twilightforest.book.yeticave.2:
what is capable of causing such an effect.

[[Next entry]]

The curse seems to be of a type too powerful for one being alone to produce. Several wizards working in combination would be necessary.
twilightforest.book.yeticave.3: If one of the wizards stopped contributing, the blizzard would calm. Strangely, my divinations do not show signs of any nearby living wizards. I did see something interesting in one of the nearby pointy-roofed towers though...
twilightforest.book.icetower.1:
[[An explorer's notebook, caked in ice]]

I overcame one blizzard, only to run into this terrible ice storm atop the glacier. My explorations have shown me the splendor of an ice palace, shining with the colors of the polar aurora. It
twilightforest.book.icetower.2:
all seems protected by some sort of curse.

[[Next entry]]

I am no novice. This curse is fed by the power of a creature nearby. The cause of the curse surrounding the fire swamp was built off the power of the leader of the
twilightforest.book.icetower.3:
minotaurs nearby.

Surrounding this glacier, there are masses of yetis. Perhaps the yetis have some sort of leader...
twilightforest.book.trollcave.1:
[[An explorer's notebook, damaged by acid]]

There seems to be no way to protect myself from the toxic rainstorm surrounding this area. In my brief excursions, I have also encountered another protection spell, similar to the
twilightforest.book.trollcave.2:
others I have witnessed. The spell must be connected to the toxic storm in some way. Further research to follow...

[[Next entry]]

Such supreme weather magic must be the result of
twilightforest.book.trollcave.3: multiple undefeated great evils in this world. My studies contain several clues pointing at a searing swamp, a forest coated in deep darkness, and a realm coated in snow.
twilightforest.book.unknown.1:
[[This book shows signs of having been copied many times]]

I cannot explain the field surrounding this structure, but the magic is powerful. If this curse is like the others, then the answer to unlocking it lies elsewhere. Perhaps there is
twilightforest.book.unknown.2: something I have left undone, or some monster I have yet to defeat. I will have to turn back. I will return to this place later, to see if anything has changed.

book.enigmaticaddons.entry.redemption_cu: These curses attached to armor are one of the trials from the path of redemption.<br2/>This curse will amplify the damage you receive. But after you complete the redemption ceremony, these curses will transform into blessings from redemption, providing you with damage resistance.
And due to its unique curse method, the Redemption Curse is incompatible with other curses, so it can be said that it can protect your armor from other curses.
book.enigmaticaddons.entry.frost_enchant: Among the common enchantment categories, you have developed several enchantments related to frost.
Frost Aspect - adds a cold aura to your weapon, causing the hit targets to slowly freeze. Of course, it cannot be combined with Fire Aspect.
Frost Protection - Provides protection against frost damage and allows you to endure longer in the cold. It cannot be combined with protective enchantments.
Frost Shattering - Enhanced the frost breaking ability of the axe, increased critical damage to fully frozen targets, and continued the freezing effect. It cannot be combined with Fire Aspect.
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.livingOde1: While in your inventory, your attacks can't
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.livingOde3: Most animals around you are rendered passive.
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.livingOde5: - Neutral animals will not actively attack.
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.livingOde6: Attack with this item to temporarily prevent the target from being
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.livingOde7_alt: protected by this and make neutral animals around it target it.
book.enigmaticaddons.entry.ode_to_living: The previous guidebook seemed unable to make all animal friends recognize you, but this hymn can soothe the emotions of some animal friends. It also inherits the functionality of the previous version of the guidebook.
The content of the ode is still too obscure for you, so you can only carry it with you for any time you need it.
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.nightScroll1: Phantoms will spawn less in your proximity.
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.nightScroll2: In the dark, you will receive the following boosts:
Although insomnia is not worth mentioning to demigods, those lurking figures in the darkness are truly annoying, with incessant cries and flying figures. You decide to use their remains to make a scroll.<br2/>The power of the dark night not only scares the Phantom, but also allows you to unleash more abilities in the darkness.
book.enigmaticaddons.entry.quartz_ring.p: When you discover quartz in the nether, you surprised by its widespread distribution in the nether. At the same time, when it comes to acquiring new materials, it seems that with your skills, you can create stronger defense rings.<br2/>However, simply exploring physical defense capabilities has already reached its limit for rings, so can we develop some other uses?

Therefore, the addition of lapis lazuli as an enchanting material in the recipe enhances the magic performance of the ring, allowing you to increase your resistance slightly when facing magic attacks. A little is better than nothing.
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.earthPromise1: When dealing damage equal to %1$s of current
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.earthPromise2: health, block this attack and then cooldown
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.earthPromise4: - Reduce the effect of the First Curse by %1$s
book.enigmaticaddons.entry.earth_promise: Whenever you watch the heart of the earth gradually break up in your hand, do you feel excited inside? The mournful cry from the depths of the earth has never become a lingering sound in your ears. But when the power of the cosmic resonates with the heart of the earth in your hands, you seem to have re recognized the true power from the earth.

The earth promise to provide protection and try to block those deadly injuries, but the gold material does not have such high tolerance, so it is important to pay attention to whether this blessing ring is in complete form.
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.forgottenIce5: - The attack target is gradually freezing
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.forgottenIce6: - Freezes those who attack you in melee
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.forgottenIce7: - Deal more damage to frozen targets
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.forgottenIce9: - You are vulnerable to Fire Damage and Fall Damage
book.enigmaticaddons.entry.forgotten_ice: When it comes to Spellstones, names that represent flames, void, and so on will occupy people's minds, but in the distant snowy plains, there is still a force waiting for you to excavate.<br2/>This spellstone awakens the power of freezing, and the frozen air slows down the fast-moving things around it. At the same time, the abilities

of Frost walker and Freezing are also included in this spellstone.<br2/>But the power of frost goes beyond that. This magic stone allows you to discover various flaws that exist in frozen creatures. But like the Will of the Ocean, you should realize that flames are still deadly.
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.lostEngine8: - Golems will not target you actively.
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.lostEngine9: - You are vulnerable to Magic Damage and Lightning Damage.
book.enigmaticaddons.entry.lost_engine.p: When you discover this spellstone, it still silently drives in the corner.<br2/>This ancient spellstone, with engine energy from the old era, can enhance your mobility and resistance, allowing you to increase your power by almost four times after squatting, while also being able to jet air to reduce the impact of gravity. Although it

makes your footsteps heavier, it also greatly increases the critical damage. The rhythm of the engine seems to resonate with the golems around it, which you think is great, especially in keeping the Shulker in neutral.<br2/>Like the Heart of the Golem, magic remains deadly.
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.revivalLeaf2: - surrounding mobs regeneration, at cost of experience.
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.revivalLeaf5: - The attack target will be poisoned.
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.revivalLeaf6: - Immune to Hunger, Poison and Withering effect.
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.revivalLeaf7: - The surrounding crops are growing faster
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.revivalLeaf9: - You are vulnerable to Fire Damage and Projectile Damage.
Another unique spellstone that gathers the power of nature can also be found in the ancient jungle temple.<br2/>This spellstone can provide the power of natural: enhance your vitality, slowly restore your health, and immunize you against some minor adverse effects and reasonably regulate bodily functions to make effects last longer.

In addition, it can also extract the deadly part from nature, leaving your hands stained with toxins. This can also resonate with crops, make surrounding crops grow more vigorously.<br2/>However, it should also be noted that besides flames, sharp arrows can easily pierce you.
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.etheriumCore6: - Convert %1$s of the damage received into
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.etheriumCore7: an increase for the next attack.
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.etheriumCore8: - Immunity to pressure, pricking and explosion damage.
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.etheriumCore9: Hold down Shift and right-click to switch armor visibility.
book.enigmaticaddons.entry.etherium_core: One is the Heart of Golem, which can be seen everywhere in the world, and the other is the extremely precious Etherium Armor. By combining the two, you can obtain this spellstone that specializes in physical defense.<br2/>After using the Heart of the Golem as an inexhaustible energy source for the Etherium Shield, you can actively

trigger the shield at any time through this spellstone, without being limited by your health condition. But not only that, the Heart of the Golem has also endowed the Shield with new abilities. It will record the damage you receive

each time, convert and accumulate it, and infuse all its power into this blow in the next attack, repaying it well.<br2/>In addition, unlike other ordinary spellstones, pure ether power seems to have no weaknesses and can be used with confidence.
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.dragonBow: You can combine this with potions.
book.enigmaticaddons.entry.dragon_bow.pa: Can Dragon Breath only be used for brewing? You may have thought about this issue. Recalling the ender dragon using its deadly dragon breath to burn your armor and skin, you also want others to experience it. And the strange dragon head hanging on the ender ship that can only be used for decoration...<br2/>Therefore, driven by various
reasons, this bow infused with magic was born.<br2/>This bow can shoot dragon breath arrows without any ammo, but it requires a slightly longer charging time. When the dragon breath arrow

hits, it will turn into a ranged dragon breath and try to retain or chase every person passing by in its way.<br2/>However, one thing to note is that this bow only allows you to utilize the power of the dragon breath. It cannot make you roam in the dragon breath Happily and Foolishly. <br2/>You may feel that this bow is too mediocre, so we will further develop its potential.
Given the role of Dragon Breath in brewing, when the potion poured onto the surface of the bow, they are gradually absorbed and merged into the transformed arrows, but its capacity was limited.
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.astralSpear2: which can quickly shoot out and
Looking at all the etherium tools, it seems that none of them can reach the enemies hovering above your head, so it's time to think about how powerful astral dust really is.<br2/>Using the Etherium Sword as the base, extending the handle, sharpening the spearhead, and finally injecting the magic of astral dust, a special spear is born.

The power of astral dust converged at the spearhead, allowing the spear to interact with energy in space. Thus, it can perceive and track every target. And it also can store energy, quickly pierce through and pour out energy, producing
a astral explosion.<br2/>Astral dust has also alienated its enchanting ability, why not try some enchantments that do not belong to swords?

<&n><&8>Notes of enchantments:<&8>
Sharpness
- Increase the damage of throwing spear.Piercing
- Increase piercing times and slightly improve tracking capabilityLoyalty
- Recall the spear automatically, faster than trident.
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.sanguinaryHandbo: If equipped the Emblem of Bloodstained Valor
or Scroll of a Thousand Curses, Pets will
also receive corresponding effects based on you.
book.enigmaticaddons.entry.sanguinary_ha: After a certain period of time, you will definitely feel that the strength of your followers is already too different from yours, and at the same time, the protection provided by the Guide to Hunt is not worth mentioning. So, you came up with a new use for twisted hearts.<br2/>This handbook has equipped your followers with new
abilities, and also receive violent power from you.<br2/>Let them listen to the proverbs in the handbook and selflessly dedicate their lives!
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.falseJustice2: - All damage you received will be converted into real damage.
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.falseJustice3: - All damage you caused will be converted into real damage.
book.enigmaticaddons.entry.false_justice: We have no way of exploring what is contained within the Acknowledgment to enable it to endlessly display knowledge. But we can use the essence of the Wither to extract the most chaotic part of  the Acknowledgment to change the rules of the battle.<br2/>At the cost of knowledge, this book begins to emit a chaotic atmosphere.

Now, all attacks related to you go beyond the original rules. Defense? Immunization? In the face of real chaos, it is nothing but an illusion. All you need to do is dodge attacks and give the target an irresistible strike.
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.xpTome2: The scroll interaction is same as Ageless Wisdom.
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.xpTome3: Improve your abilities based on experience level,
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.xpTome4: But the EXP gained from experience orb will decrease,
book.enigmaticaddons.entry.cursed_xp_scr: When your period reaches a certain stage, experience may not be very useful except for being used for others, but now, through the power of curse, the nature of this scroll has undergone a huge change.<br2/>The greedy curse of ignorance expands the hunting range of the scroll and devours most of the experience gained, leaving you with very little.

Of course, the benefits brought by curse should not be underestimated, greatly enhancing your combat abilities. And please remember that the curse is always waiting for chances. When you are most vulnerable, it will take everything away.
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.thunderScroll2: Deal more damage to armored targets.
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.thunderScroll3: After being hit much times,the target
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.thunderScroll4: will be struck by lightning bolt.
book.enigmaticaddons.entry.thunder_scrol: Although the Will of Ocean can partly control the lightning, this is ultimately only indirect control and not fast enough.<br2/>We use the divine power to write spells that resonate with lightning onto scrolls, using spellstone as the foundation and swords as the medium to release the power. During the battle, this scroll will drive you to use sweeping attacks
to expand the target of lightning. At the same time, electric attacks can also make it easier for you to penetrate the influence of armor, allowing you to better face high armor or group enemies.
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.hellBladeCharm2: - All damage you caused will be doubled.
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.hellBladeCharm3: - When your damage reaches %1$s of the target's health,
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.hellBladeCharm4: - causing significant additional damage and heal yourself.
book.enigmaticaddons.entry.hell_blade_ch: This charm seems to have been waiting for your arrival somewhere in nether, waiting for you to nurture it with your own blood.<br2/>Anyone who notices the powerful power this charm gives, even if it honestly indicates the cost, will inevitably be tempted to wear it. Generally speaking, these wearers end up with a
very foolish death.<br2/>So, please wear this charm carefully, especially those who bear the seven curses at the same time.
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.forgerGem2: Half the experience required for forging
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.forgerGem3: and making your anvil more durable.
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.forgerGem4: Two unused tools without any enchantment
book.enigmaticaddons.entry.forger_gem.pa: Forging items is an inevitable step to strength enhancement, but before reach the perfection, there will always be concerns due to expensive costs or anvil breakage.<br2/>This accessory will directly inject ancient forging techniques into your hands, effectively reducing the probability of anvil breakage, and utilizing the energy of
the gem to reduce the cost, thereby increasing the upper limit of forging.<br2/>In addition, exquisite craft also allows you to create some Unbreakable creations with two identical new tools.
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.despairInsignia: Maybe a bit different from usual.
book.enigmaticaddons.entry.adventure_cha: Creation and destruction are the supreme power of the God, but sometimes it can be difficult to grasp the force well, and a slight mistake can easily lead to unnecessary destruction. And in pure combat, you would prefer to transform this power into more practical forms.<br2/>Now this charm may temporarily meet your needs, converting
destructive power into a small amount of combat boost. Of course, this charm will not occupy your precious slots, and whether or not to equip it is entirely up to your choice.
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.voidTome: Use to obtain +1 Arcane Scroll Slot.
book.enigmaticaddons.entry.void_tome.pag: This extraordinary book lies quietly in a corner of the overworld, waiting for those who crave knowledge to find its existence.<br2/>Once you open this ominous book, your brain seems to be connected to an endless void, with a large number of intangible things flooding into your mind, dispersing all perceptions and teasing every

nerve. It seems like whispering to you about the mysterious arcane...<br2/>When you come to your senses, the book disappears, leaving only a sharp headache and a new understanding of the Arcane Scroll
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.antiqueBag1: A container similar to a Ender Chest.
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.antiqueBag2: The books stored in will be considered
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.antiqueBag4: The item still works in the Ender Chest.
book.enigmaticaddons.entry.antique_bag.p: This is another mysterious relic that can be found in the midst of nameless ruins. It emits a faint magical light in its dim appearance, just like this ordinary cloth bag, but inside it there is a mysterious magical space.<br2/>But this relic seems to have its own temper, only reluctantly accepting when you put in a book.

However, miraculously, every time you store a book, some knowledge that does not belong to you immediately comes to mind. This can greatly save storage space and allow some items that are not working on their own to take effect.
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.astralPotion1: Behold, the stars has rich taste!
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.astralPotion2: You think you shouldn't drink too much...
book.enigmaticaddons.entry.astral_potion: Star dust has enormous potential in potion brewing, which you must have experienced before. But when faced with some unfamiliar potions, it seems that you cannot simply catalyze their stardust, let alone those effects that cannot be obtained from potions.<br2/>You turned your sight to honey.
From the results, it appears that this mysterious substance can prolong the duration of the potion effects on you. But if you want another bottle, emm, be careful of the consequences...
book.enigmaticaddons.entry.primeval_cube:
You have discovered this ancient record, which seems to be about the rebirth of spellstones.Under the catalysis of the radiance of the stars...
Six becomes one...
Accompanied by the power of two "Heart".Why not try to throw it onto the Sack of Astral Dust?
book.enigmaticaddons.entry.ichor_droplet: For this so-called "blood of gods", you have finally discovered a stable source to obtain, which is to hunt for screaming ghasts floating in the Nether.<br2/>The power of the curse triggered the tiny residual "divinity" in the blood and tears of the ghast, allowing the Ichor to reappear in front of everyone.

However, do not ponder where these 'divinity' actually comes from, as it has long been a secret of ancient times. For you now, all you need to think about is how to utilize and develop this unexpected product. For example, brewing some extreme potions.
book.enigmaticaddons.entry.ichoroot.name: Ichoroot
book.enigmaticaddons.entry.ichoroot.page: When people are arguing over carrots and potatoes, the neglected beetroot appears particularly pitiful. Now with the assistance of ichor, let it be refreshed!<br2/>Only a small amount of ichor is needed to double the nutrition of beetroot and make it easy to digest, while also demonstrating divinity and purification power within it.
Ichor can purify the negative effects and provide absorption. After consuming a certain amount, the protection of divinity will be revealed to resist certain harm for you.
book.enigmaticaddons.entry.ichor_spear.p: You should know that the noble ichor are always different from ordinary beings, especially when they drip onto armor and make a sizzling sound.<br2/>Carefully apply the ichor droplet onto the stable gold spearhead, along with other catalysts, and simply spear is completed. By piercing it into the enemy's armor, the danger
ichor will corrode their armor and weaken their defense. <br2/>But there is a fatal problem - the spear is disposable. This can only be compensated for by its simple and easily accessible features.
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.scorchedCharm1: Immunize the wearer against most of the fire damage
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.scorchedCharm2: And be able to walk on the lava.
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.scorchedCharm3: Obtain natural regeneration when in contact with lava.
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.scorchedCharm4: Trigger lifesteal when attacking a target on fire.
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.scorchedCharm5: Probability to resist the attack damage.
book.enigmaticaddons.entry.scorched_char: To purify the power of flames, in addition to protection, we also need more auxiliary abilities.<br2/>Unlike Frost Walker, this charm allows you to walk directly on lava without the need to transform it into other strange objects, making it easier for you to travel in the Nether.

In addition, with the power of ichor, this charm has awakened some blessings from ancient times, which can turn the heat in lava into the driving force of life. And the blessing itself seems to be called the 'Seven Suns'.
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.theBless1: In the endless journey of suffering,
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.theBless2: using this to light up the way forward.
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.theBless3: Causing more damage to the target on fire and
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.theBless4: remove the beneficial effects on it.
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.theBless5: The holder will not catch fire and
book.enigmaticaddons.entry.the_bless.pag: This is still a book of knowledge, existing on both sides of The Twist as one.<br2/>By utilizing the nefarious essence, the purification effect of ichor shifts this book towards a more conservative side, increasing your chances of surviving frequent hits and making you immune to unquenchable flames. This is one of the blessing.
Of course, this book is not limited to this, incineration power of The Acknowledgment is further strengthened here, removing all the gospel of the incinerator and giving them a more severe blow.
book.enigmaticaddons.entry.pure_heart.pa: With different materials, you may be able to try a production different from Twisted Heart. The combination of hidden dark pollution and faint divinity gave birth to this eerie creation with bright appearance.<br2/>Unlike another type of item, the Pure Heart and its creations typically provide protection and assistance,

rather than aggressive power.<br2/>But although it is a divine creation, it needs to rely on the power of curses, which is too ironic. So when using these items, please also pay attention to the hidden dangers.
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.blessAmplifier1: Combine with any enchanted item in a crafting grid
book.enigmaticaddons.entry.bless_amplifi: After the baptism of Ichor, the desire for the book has transformed from acquisition to giving, further enhancing the magical power in the item.<br2/>If you allow it to come in close contact with any enchanted item, it'll sacrifice itself and double the level of enchantments in the item.

Breaking the limitations of the enchantments to a higher level is its true purpose.<br2/>By the way, not all limitation can be broken, and there are also some enchantments that cannot withstand the power and become ineffective.
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.blessStone1: Take this stone to seek death,
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.blessStone2: hen the Ring of the Seven Curses will
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.blessStone3: transform into the Ring of Redemption.
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.blessStone_info_: A ritual exclusive to the hardcore is...
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.blessStone1_hard: The tenacious will allows the curses to compromise
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.blessStone2_hard: Let's begin the transaction of souls
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.blessStone_hardc: The Hardcore can also be overcome.
book.enigmaticaddons.entry.bless_stone.p: When you are hesitating whether to sacrifice yourself to break free from the Seven Curse Ring, there is a brand new choice in front of you.<br2/>The biggest problem is the Loss of Soul, and with the current materials and methods, it seems impossible. Although we can't break the connection, we could let the connection be presented in a new way.

Slowly infiltrate a little pure power into the Ring of Seven Curses, and mobilize the blessings to change the curses. However, all these operations still need to be carried out when the contact is vulnerable, that is, you need to face death.

After the final soul loss, the Ring of Seven Curses will completely disappear from your sight and turn into a touch of gold on your hand.<br2/>The previous curses has completely disappeared, also the original blessing has been partially preserved. Although most of the objects that once

accompanied you are no longer usable, there are still some things that bear witness to your past filled with suffering, which is constantly approaching death. They still recognize your qualifications, are willing to break the shackles of the curse for you. <br2/>May you enjoy life to the fullest on days away from the curses. But you cannot truly understand this ring, please do not make the choice easily.
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.blessRing1: For those who have experienced torment,
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.blessRing3: - You receive %1$s damage from ANY source.
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.blessRing4: - Increase the damage you cause by %1$s
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.blessRing9: - You can create and use unique relics.
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.blessRingLore1: This ring shines with a unique
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.blessRingLore3: of torment, and also, it is a
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.blessUse1: This item understands your past experiences,
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.blessUse2: and it still recognizes your qualifications.
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.evilDagger2: Apply fatal curse to the target
book.enigmaticaddons.entry.evil_dagger.p: A mysterious weapon crafted from Nefarious Ingot, with endless evil thoughts gathered at the tip of the blade, greedily waiting for the soul to feast.<br2/>As its name suggests, The Curse Carver is able to imprint a unique curse on your soul. Once this indelible curse begins to take effect, the cage of evil thoughts will bind your

actions and hurt your soul bite by bite until they are satisfied. For targets with outstanding vitality, their greedy nature leads them to demand more. When satisfied, they begin to tear apart your soul, pouring out from within

as if trying to completely destroy this useless container.<br2/>In addition, they will no longer look at containers that have already been enjoyed, so this curse has a fatal weakness, which is disposable.
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.totemofMalice1: When in the inventory or curio slot:
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.totemofMalice5: Causing damage to the surroundings when triggered.
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.totemofMalice5_a: Causing damage to the surroundings when triggered.
book.enigmaticaddons.entry.totem_of_mali: We have no idea about how the illagers created totems of undying, but behind each totem there must be sacrifices of living beings.<br2/>But now, using the nefarious essence to release the malice of these sealed souls, mobilizing their anger towards illagers, to fulfill their final desire for revenge.
As their wish for revenge has been fulfilled, they will not forget their duty. They are still willing to protect you in the most dangerous moments and release themselves to attack the enemies around.
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.disasterSword1: Each level of Bad Omen effect increases damage by %1$s
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.disasterSword2: Right-click can provide powerful but brief blocking
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.disasterSword3: Successful blocking can strengthen the next attack
book.enigmaticaddons.entry.disaster_swor: With a sturdy blade and a soul poised to take off, this sword showcases the skills of defense and counterattack.<br2/>Holding this broadsword, you can use its wide blade to block almost all attacks. Given its heaviness, any attack becomes indistinguishable, but you can only lift the sword for a moment.
Whenever successfully blocked, the energy absorbed will linger on the sword, waiting for the perfect release in the next attack.<br2/>The rhythm of disaster gradually emerged in this crisp sound.
tooltip.enigmaticaddons.chaosElytra3: the ground, it will cause range damage.
Since the Heart of Abyss is in hand, why not set your gaze on the sky?<br2/>Based on the same process as the Majestic Elytra, using more evil and powerful materials can obtain these stronger elytra. Soar in the sky with the power of the cosmic and the ender, to look down upon the creatures crawling on the ground.
When we descend from the sky to the ground, chaos and evil will accompany us, bringing impact to the ground and putting everything in chaos.
death.attack.false_justice: %1$s disappeared into the void of judgement.
book.enigmaticaddons.entry.frozen_heart_: Blue ice, the purest existence in the ice block family. After careful consideration, you decided to add it to the brewing process as an attempt.<br2/>After tasting, although it is too cold, you find that there is no feeling of coldness in your body. Instead, it allows you to feel the power from those cold air in the snowy mountains and glaciers.
Ultimately, you will gain the ability to immune freeze and be able to apply a cold aura to others, and deal more damage to those frozen targets.
Its effect can be extended using redstone dust.
You can also brew it into splash...
...or lingering types, just like you can any other regular potion.
