tooltip.relics.holy_locket.ability.steal: Redirects a part of the regenerated health of nearby creatures to the wearer of the relic.
tooltip.relics.magic_mirror.leveling: +1 experience point for each use of the «Wormhole» ability, +1 experience point for every 50 blocks to the teleportation point.
tooltip.relics.magic_mirror.ability.tele: After use, teleports the wearer to their respawn point.
tooltip.relics.shadow_glaive.leveling: +1 experience point for every 2 glaive bounces from the «Blind Justice» ability.
tooltip.relics.shadow_glaive.ability.gla: Usage releases one of 8 glaive charges, bouncing between nearby targets. The missing charges are restored themselves after a certain amount of time.
tooltip.relics.shadow_glaive.ability.saw: Usage consumes all 8 glaive charges, summoning a saw that deals damage to nearby targets. Reuse will return the saw to the wearer, restoring all charges. Automatic charge regeneration is blocked while the ability is active.
tooltip.relics.arrow_quiver.leveling: +1 experience point for every 10 blocks to the target hit by the shot.
tooltip.relics.arrow_quiver.ability.rece: Shooting primarily uses arrows from the quiver's internal storage. Pressing the LMB with arrow on the quiver in the inventory will place it in the internal storage of the relic. Pressing the RMB on the quiver will get the last stack of arrows placed in it.
tooltip.relics.arrow_quiver.ability.leap: Knocks the player away from the looking direction, inflicting a vanishing effect until landing. Using a bow will suspend the player in mid-air, increasing damage and nullifying gravity for the next critical shot.
tooltip.relics.arrow_quiver.ability.agil: Increases the speed of bowstring tension.
tooltip.relics.arrow_quiver.ability.rain: Calls on a point along the line of sight an area of falling homing arrows from the internal quiver storage from the «Arrow Storage» ability. The arrows themselves from the storage are not consumed. Only one area from this ability can exist at a time.
tooltip.relics.blazing_flask.leveling: +1 experience point for every 5 seconds of flight within the scope of the ability «Eternal Fire».
tooltip.relics.blazing_flask.ability.bon: Using a relic on a block will create a restricted flight zone, the size of which depends on the amount of fire in a certain radius around the center.
tooltip.relics.elytra_booster.leveling: +1 experience point for every 10 seconds of burning fuel when placing it in the internal buffer of the relic from the ability «Acceleration».
tooltip.relics.elytra_booster.ability.bo: Using any combustible fuel on a relic in the inventory replenishes its internal buffer. Using the ability during the flight on an elytra rushes the wearer forward, consuming fuel from the internal buffer.
tooltip.relics.midnight_robe.leveling: +1 experience point for every 2 units of damage when attacking while being invisible from the «Disappearing» ability.
tooltip.relics.midnight_robe.ability.van: Gives the wearer complete invisibility and increases the speed of their movement at a sufficiently low light level.
tooltip.relics.midnight_robe.ability.bac: An attack from the «Vanish» ability deals increased damage, outlining a circle around the target and dispelling the invisibility effect of the wearer. Reuse of the «Vanish» ability is possible only after the wearer leaves the circle.
tooltip.relics.reflection_necklace.level: +1 experience point for every 10 damage accumulated in the internal buffer of the relic from the ability «Infernal Hatred».
tooltip.relics.reflection_necklace.abili: Accumulates the damage received by the wearer into the internal buffer of the relic. 5 seconds after the last damage or in case of a buffer overflow, the relic explodes, throwing obsidian fragments in all directions, causing damage and stunning targets.
tooltip.relics.jellyfish_necklace.leveli: +1 experience point for each activation of the ability «Electric Discharge».
tooltip.relics.jellyfish_necklace.abilit: The wearer does not sink in water.
Deals damage to targets when colliding with them.
When the ability is triggered, «Electric Discharge» imposes a paralysis effect on the target.
tooltip.relics.spore_sack.leveling:
+1 experience point for each spore released by the «Poison Synthesis» ability.
+1 experience point for each additional spore split by the «Decomposition» ability.
When taking damage, throws a spore in a random direction that sticks to surfaces and explodes when a target approaches, dealing damage, poisoning, slowing, and blocking healing for 5 seconds.
tooltip.relics.spore_sack.ability.buffer: Each time the «Poison Synthesis» ability cooldown triggers, accumulates one charge into the relic's internal buffer that can be used by other abilities to release spores. Adds a chance not to consume spores from the internal buffer when requesting charges for other abilities.
tooltip.relics.spore_sack.ability.multip: Each spore can split into several smaller spores within a given range when it explodes. The maximum number of spores is determined by the degree of the main spore size, but the final number is limited by the first unsuccessful chance of spore division.
tooltip.relics.spore_sack.ability.explos: Empties the relic's buffer, releasing all accumulated spore charges into the world. The size of the released spores depends on the wearer's missing health.
tooltip.relics.ice_breaker.leveling: +1 experience point for every 3 blocks in the fall before triggering the ability «Earthquake».
tooltip.relics.ice_breaker.ability.susta: Increases the speed of falling, increases the knockback resistance and negates slippering.
tooltip.relics.ice_breaker.ability.impac: Using the ability in a fall will create a shockwave at the landing site, causing damage and throwing away nearby targets. Power of the wave depends on the distance that the wearer has flown.
tooltip.relics.bastion_ring.leveling:
+1/5/10 experience point for each killed Zombified Piglin / Piglin / Piglin Brute.
+1 experience point for each additional trade from the ability «Respect».
tooltip.relics.bastion_ring.ability.comp: Makes piglins neutral in relation to the wearer. The nearest piglin will indicate the location of a bastion nearby.
tooltip.relics.bastion_ring.ability.trad: Each trade with piglins gets a multiple chance of 50% to issue an additional trading result.
tooltip.relics.horse_flute.leveling: +1 experience point for every 25 blocks overcome by a horse called by the ability «Portable Stall».
tooltip.relics.horse_flute.ability.paddo: Using a relic on the horse will move the animal to the internal storage. Reuse will release the creature. If the distance between the wearer and the summoned horse exceeds 16 blocks, it will automatically fit back into the flute.
A horse placed in the internal storage will slowly restore health.
tooltip.relics.magma_walker.leveling: +1 experience point for every 5 units of heating from the ability «Fiery Tread».
tooltip.relics.magma_walker.ability.pace: For a certain amount of time allows you to walk on the lava surface without falling and taking damage. After the time limit expires, the boots begin to overheat and cause damage to the wearer proportional to the degree of overheating.
tooltip.relics.aqua_walker.leveling: +1 experience point for every 5 units of getting wet from the ability «Moisture Resistance».
tooltip.relics.aqua_walker.ability.walki: For a certain amount of time allows you to move on the surface of the water without falling. After the time limit expires, the boots begin to sink, dragging the wearer with them under the water.
tooltip.relics.drowned_belt.leveling: +1 experience point for each level of enchantment «Riptide» on the trident when using it.
tooltip.relics.drowned_belt.ability.slot: Increases the maximum number of slots for equipping relics.
tooltip.relics.drowned_belt.ability.anch: Reduces the swimming speed and increases the sinking speed of the wearer.
tooltip.relics.drowned_belt.ability.ript: Allows you to use the trident «Riptide» ability without rain or water, adding recharge time to it.
tooltip.relics.hunter_belt.leveling: +1 experience point for each attack made by the wearer's pet.
tooltip.relics.hunter_belt.ability.slots: Increases the maximum number of slots for equipping relics.
tooltip.relics.hunter_belt.ability.train: Increases the damage inflicted by the wearer's pets.
tooltip.relics.leather_belt.leveling: +1 experience point for each experience gained by equipped talismans.
tooltip.relics.leather_belt.ability.slot: Increases the maximum number of slots for equipping relics.
tooltip.relics.rage_glove.leveling:
+1 experience point for every 3 charges from the ability «Berserker Rage» when they are reset.
+1 experience point for each target hit by the «Spurt» ability.
tooltip.relics.rage_glove.ability.rage.d: Each wearer attack made within 3 seconds after the last one accumulates 1 charge into the internal buffer of the relic. The damage inflicted and received by the wearer, as well as its movement speed and dealt damage increases in proportion to the accumulated charges. After 3 seconds, the internal buffer of the relic is emptied, canceling all bonuses received.
tooltip.relics.rage_glove.ability.phlebo: Increases the wearer's attack and movement speed, as well as granting passive regeneration proportional to the percentage of the missing health.
Dashes towards the direction of sight, setting enemies on fire, applying bleeding and attacking each target in its path with the item in the hand. Deals additional damage proportional to the number of charges in the relic's internal buffer from the «Berserker's Rage» ability and devastates it.
tooltip.relics.ice_skates.leveling: +1 experience point for each second of acceleration from the ability «Skating».
tooltip.relics.ice_skates.ability.skatin: Increases the movement speed while on ice depending on the duration of sliding.
tooltip.relics.ice_skates.ability.ram.de: When colliding with targets, deals damage proportional to the duration of «Skating» ability usage.
tooltip.relics.amphibian_boot.leveling:
+1 experience point for each second of acceleration from the «Fins» ability.
+1 experience point for every second of acceleration from the «Slipping» ability.
tooltip.relics.amphibian_boot.ability.sw: Accelerates the swimming speed depending on its duration.
tooltip.relics.amphibian_boot.ability.sl: Increases movement speed in the rain depending on its duration.
tooltip.relics.amphibian_boot.ability.gi: Grants player the ability to not consume air while underwater.
tooltip.relics.spatial_sign.leveling: +1 experience point for each second of return from the ability «Time rift».
tooltip.relics.spatial_sign.ability.seal: When used, returns the wearer along the route traveled after a certain amount of time. Repeated use will terminate the ability.
tooltip.relics.chorus_inhibitor.leveling: +1 experience point for every 10 blocks to the teleportation point from the «Teleportation Control» ability.
Using the chorus fruit teleports the wearer to the block along the line of sight within reach.
tooltip.relics.wool_mitten.leveling: +1 experience point for every 5 units of size when hit by a snowball from the ability «Mold».
Collecting snow using RMB with an empty hand gradually forms special solid snowballs. Hitting such a snowball on the target will cause damage and stun it, as well as freeze targets nearby. Holding a snowball without an equipped relic also freezes the wearer.
tooltip.relics.roller_skates.leveling: +1 experience point for each second of acceleration from the ability «Acceleration».
tooltip.relics.roller_skates.ability.ska: Increases the movement speed depending on its duration. All blocks become slippery for the wearer.
tooltip.relics.space_dissector.leveling: +1 experience point for each created portal if there is no existing one
tooltip.relics.space_dissector.ability.d: Holding RMB creates a portal on a point along the line of sight, stopping holding RMB creates a second portal using the same principle, linking it to the first one. Bringing a living creature to one of the portals will move it to the linked portal. Portals don't work if there are any solid blocks in their path.

injects them into Repurposed Structure's loot tables.
Example: Snowy Pyramid gets all modded items that
vanilla Desert Temple can have
repurposed_structures.midnightconfig.bla:
Add the identifiers for Repurposed Structures's loottable you
want to turn off the automatic modded item importing code for.
Separate multiple entries with a comma.
Example:
"repurposed_structures:chests/mansions/birch,
repurposed_structures:chests/mineshafts/jungle"

item.celestisynth.poltergeist.passive_de: All skills of this weapon tags every affected entity with a Phantom Tag. Slain foes with the tag become monstrous Aberrants that draw in nearby entities for 5 seconds.
item.celestisynth.poltergeist.desc_1: Executes a mighty strike that inflicts significant harm over a broad range, devastating multiple adversaries. Delivering another crushing blow following a sequence of ten consecutive strikes generates an immense impact, summoning an Aberrant entity. The cooldown for this ability instantly resets when casted while airborne.
item.celestisynth.poltergeist.desc_2: Creates a protective barrier capable of shattering any incoming projectiles while forcefully propelling the player backwards.
advancement.celestisynth.obtain_aquaflor: When the flowers bloom that day
item.celestisynth.aquaflora.passive_desc: Every skill cast gives 3 seconds of speed to the caster.
item.celestisynth.aquaflora.desc_1: Launches a series of attacks capable of penetrating a row of entities.
item.celestisynth.aquaflora.desc_2: Uses a head-butt against a group of entities, pushing them away and inflicting significant damage. Activating this ability initiates the Blooming State, altering the weapon's skill set.
item.celestisynth.aquaflora.desc_3: During the execution of this skill, the player becomes immune to damage while delivering up to 20 individual attacks on entities within range. Dual wielding the same weapon enables the player to perform up to 40+ attacks, albeit with decreased damage.
item.celestisynth.aquaflora.condition_4: Activate: Right-click while holding SHIFT during Blooming State
item.celestisynth.aquaflora.desc_4: The player executes a backward dash, leaving a floral effect that draws nearby entities toward it. This ability deactivates the Blooming State, resulting in a modification of the weapon's skill set.
item.celestisynth.rainfall_serenity.skil: Eons, and Eons Through the Sky
item.celestisynth.rainfall_serenity.desc: When the bow is released, it emits a laser that can pierce through every entity, marking each with a "Quasar Mark" for 5 seconds. This mark can trigger nearby entities to shoot lasers at the marked target.
When the laser strikes a target with a "Quasar Mark", a portal spawns above and lasers will rain down around the target.

minecolonies.config.gameplay.comment: All configuration items related to the core gameplay
minecolonies.config.claims.comment: All configuration related to colony claims

minecolonies.config.neighborbuildingrend: By default, when placing a schematic near other buildings, the already-placed buildings will show as if they were at level 5 and have a blue outline around them. You can disable that by setting this to false.
minecolonies.config.neighborbuildingrang: How close a building needs to be to another to be considered a neighbor, in blocks. -1 = intersecting, 0 = touching
minecolonies.config.buildgogglerange.com: How close (in blocks) you need to be to see work orders while wearing the Build Goggles.
minecolonies.config.colonyteamborders: Show Colony Borders in Team Colors
minecolonies.config.colonyteamborders.co: When true, the colony borders shown when holding the build tool will be in the colony's team color. When false, the colony you're inside will be white and any other colony will be red.
minecolonies.config.diseasemodifier.comm: How common diseases are. 1 = Very common, 100 = extremely rare.
minecolonies.config.diseases.comment: All diseases citizens can get. The name, how common it is, and all ingredients to cure it.
minecolonies.config.configliststudyitems: Items consumed by citizens in the Library.
minecolonies.config.generatesupplyloot.c: Whether to generate supply ships and camps in loot chests.
minecolonies.config.forceloadcolony.comm: If part of the colony is loaded by an owner/officer, should the colony be kept loaded? (Set how many chunks are loaded with the "Colony Chunk Loading Strictness" option.)
minecolonies.config.loadtime.comment: Set how long chunks stay loaded after player leaves, does not persist through restarts. Default: 10min
minecolonies.config.colonyloadstrictness: This controls how many chunks are loaded with the "Chunk Load Colony" option. The higher this value, the fewer chunks will be loaded. (The innermost chunks will be loaded first.) 1 = load all claimed chunks.
minecolonies.config.badvisitorchance.com: Chance to get an evil Tavern visitor that will run off with the resources you give them. This is a %.
minecolonies.config.researchcreativecomp: Allows automatic and (near) instant completion of research for players in creative mode. If false, creative players will still be able to begin researches, but will have normal progress rates.
minecolonies.config.researchdebuglog.com: Significantly increases the amount of information related to research datapacks that is logged during the world load.
minecolonies.config.researchresetcost: Cost to Undo a Completed Research
minecolonies.config.researchresetcost.co: A list of items to charge players when undoing an already-completed research.
minecolonies.config.listofplantables.com: The items and item-tags that the Florist can plant.
item.minecolonies.scepterlumberjack.used: Position A set. Select Position B with a right-click or discard tool when finished.
Position B set. Select Position A with a left-click or discard tool when finished.
item.minecolonies.scepterlumberjack.rest: A zone of %d blocks is too large. The maximum restricted volume for the Forester is %d blocks.
Forester restricted zone set (x: %d to %d, y: %d to %d, z: %d to %d, total: %d blocks). The max size is %d blocks.
minecolonies.config.maxtreesize.comment: Max log count in one tree for the Forester to check during their tree search.
minecolonies.config.nosupplyplacementres: Disables supply camp placing restrictions, intended for skyworlds and similar
minecolonies.config.skyraiders: Enable raiders to spawn in the sky
minecolonies.config.skyraiders.comment: Raiders will spawn in the sky if this is enabled
minecolonies.config.disableemptycolonies: Will stop empty colonies from being generated in the world - Needs world Reload
minecolonies.config.averageemptycolonydi: Average Empty Colony Distance - Needs Complete Restart
Average distance in chunks between 2 empty colonies
minecolonies.config.builderplaceconstruc: Should construction tape be placed around in-construction builds?
minecolonies.config.allowinfinitesupplyc: Should players be able to place an infinite amount of supply camps/ships?
minecolonies.config.allowinfinitecolonie: Should players be allowed to abandon their colony to create a new one easily? Note: This is buggy!
minecolonies.config.allowotherdimcolonie: Should colonies in other dimensions be allowed?
minecolonies.config.citizenrespawninterv: If a colony is under the initial citizen count, this changes the amount of time before a new citizen spawns.
minecolonies.config.builderbuildblockdel: Delay after each block placement (increasing it increases the delay).
minecolonies.config.blockminingdelaymodi: Delay modifier to mine a block (decreasing it decreases the delay).
minecolonies.config.enableindevelopmentf: Should development features be enabled (might be buggy)?
Should citizen name tags be rendered?
minecolonies.config.workersalwaysworkinr: Should workers work during the rain?
minecolonies.config.sendenteringleavingm: Should players be sent entering/leaving colony notifications?
minecolonies.config.allowglobalnamechang: Should players be allowed to change citizen names? -1 for false, 0 for certain players only, 1 for true. (To set which players can change the names, see "Special Permissions Group" below.)
minecolonies.config.holidayfeatures.comm: Should special holiday content be displayed?
minecolonies.config.updaterate.comment: AI Update rate. Increase this to improve performance. This throttles citizen updates.
minecolonies.config.dirtfromcompost.comm: Quantity of dirt per compost filling.
minecolonies.config.luckyblockchance.com: Chance for the Miner to get an ore when mining cobblestone or stone (by default, can be expanded with datapacks to other materials). This is a percentage. (To change which ores the Miner can find, see "List of Lucky Ores".)
minecolonies.config.minthleveltoteleport: The minimum level a Town Hall has to be to allow teleportation to allied colonies.
minecolonies.config.suggestbuildtoolplac: Suggest build tool usage when trying to place a building without the build tool.

Should players be allowed to use the /mc rtp command?

minecolonies.config.canplayeruseallytown: Can players teleport to allied colonies?

minecolonies.config.canplayeruseshowcolo: Can Players Use the Show Colony Info Command
Should players be allowed to use the /mc colony info command?
minecolonies.config.canplayerusekillciti: Can Players Use the Kill Citizens Command

minecolonies.config.canplayerusedeleteco: Can Players Use the Delete Colony Command
Should players be allowed to use the /mc colony delete command?
minecolonies.config.numberofattemptsfors: Number of Attempts for Safe TP
Amount of attempts to find a safe random teleport (with /mc rtp).
minecolonies.config.maxcolonysize.commen: Maximum claim range for a colony. This is the radius, measured in chunks.
minecolonies.config.mincolonydistance.co: The minimum distance (in chunks) between colonies.
minecolonies.config.initialcolonysize.co: Initial claim size for a colony. This is the radius, measured in chunks.
minecolonies.config.restrictcolonyplacem: Should the min/max distance from spawn also affect colony placement?
minecolonies.config.enabledynamiccolonys: Should colonies have a fixed radius or should it be dynamic?
minecolonies.config.maxdistancefromworld: Max distance (in blocks) from world spawn for a colony.
minecolonies.config.mindistancefromworld: Min distance (in blocks) from world spawn for a colony.
minecolonies.config.officersreceiveadvan: Should officers of a colony receive advancements from that colony?
minecolonies.config.dobarbariansspawn.co: Whether or not to spawn raiders.
minecolonies.config.maxbarbariansize.com: The max size of a raider horde.
minecolonies.config.dobarbariansbreakthr: Whether or not raiders can break through obstacles
minecolonies.config.shouldraiderbreakdoo: Whether or not raiders can break through doors.
minecolonies.config.averagenumberofnight: Average Number of Nights Between Raids
The average number of nights between raids.
minecolonies.config.minimumnumberofnight: Minimum Number of Nights Between Raids
The minimum number of nights between raids.
minecolonies.config.citizencallforhelp.c: Should citizens call Guards for help when attacked?
minecolonies.config.rangerdamagemult.com: Attack damage multiplier for Archer Guards.
minecolonies.config.knightdamagemult.com: Attack damage multiplier for Knight Guards.
minecolonies.config.pvp_mode.comment: Turn on MineColonies PVP mode (colonies can be destroyed and griefed under certain conditions).
minecolonies.config.daysuntilpirateships: Days until the pirate ships despawn.
minecolonies.config.maxyforbarbarians.co: Max Y level (height) for Raiders to spawn.
minecolonies.config.maxkeptbackups.comme: Set the max amount of backups kept
minecolonies.config.turnoffexplosionsinc: Independent from the colony protection, should explosions be turned off inside colonies? DAMAGE_NOTHING prevents explosions completely. DAMAGE_PLAYERS, allows explosions to damage players and hostile mobs, but not blocks or neutral or friendly mobs. DAMAGE_ENTITIES allows damage to all entities. DAMAGE_EVERYTHING allows explosions to damage entities and blocks.
minecolonies.config.specialpermgroup.com: Players who have special permissions, especially to change citizen names (see "Name Changes" above).
minecolonies.config.freetointeractblocks: Blocks players should be able to interact with in any colony (ex: vending machines)
minecolonies.config.secondsbetweenpermis: Seconds between each permission message (to reduce spam).
minecolonies.config.dynamictreeharvestsi: Forester harvest trunk size for dynamic trees: 1-8.
minecolonies.config.siftermeshes.comment: List of materials a sifter can use as a mesh material, along with bonus weights
minecolonies.config.siftableblocks.comme: List of materials a Sifter can rifle through for resources.
minecolonies.config.sifterdrops.comment: List of materials a sifter can find from raw materials, as well as their weights.
minecolonies.config.crusherproduction.co: List of materials a Crusher can reduce and what they convert into, separated by exclamation marks.
minecolonies.config.fishingroddurability: Offset for the maximum durability unenchanted rod a T1 Fishing Hut can use, compared to other wooden tools (59). Vanilla rods always work, but equivalents would need +6. Default value allows up to Thermal Foundation Silver  Anything below -59 will only allow vanilla rods.

Offset for the maximum durability unenchanted rod a T2 Fishing Hut can use, compared to iron tools (250). Thermal Foundation Iron requires +6. T3 huts can use unenchanted rods of any durability level, so long as they can take damage at all. Anything below -250 will only allow vanilla rods, except as allowed by T1.
minecolonies.config.auditcraftingtags.co: When loading recipes, generate audit CSV files to help debug datapacks or extra mods.
minecolonies.config.blueprintbuildmode.c: Turn this on if you're using this world for blueprint building and scanning.
minecolonies.config.luckyores.comment: List of ore blocks rarely found magically by Miners (see "Ore Chance"). Includes the block and its chance, separated by exclamation marks.
minecolonies.config.minimumrailstopath.c: Minimum number of consecutive rails for citizens to use them.
minecolonies.config.pathfindingmaxthread: Amount of additional threads to be used for pathfinding.
Max amount of nodes (positions) to map during pathfinding. Lowering increases performance, but might lead to pathing glitches.
minecolonies.config.enabledebuglogging.c: Should the request system show debug information in the debug.log? Useful if malfunctioning.
minecolonies.config.maximalretries.comme: The maximal amount of tries that the request system will perform for retryable requests. Higher increases server load.
The amount of ticks between retries of the request system for retryable requests. Lower increases server load.
minecolonies.config.creativeresolve.comm: Should the request system creatively resolve (if possible) when the player is required to resolve a request? This is a debugging tool and can take a very long time to resolve a request.
minecolonies.config.canplayeruseresetcom: Can Players Use the Request System Reset Command
Should players be allowed to use the /mc colony requestsystem-reset command?

com.minecolonies.coremod.info.builder.0:
The Builder is the heart of your colony. Without them, you wouldn't be able to get anything done!
 Every hut worker has to have their building built to at least level 1 before they can do anything, except the Builder. If the Builder has a hut at level 0 (no hut), they can only build one thing, their own hut.

 For your Builder to build, upgrade, reposition, or repair a hut that isn't their own, their hut must be at least the same level as the other hut. For example, the Builder's Hut must be level 3 or above to build a level 3 hut.
com.minecolonies.coremod.info.builder.1:
Let's cover builder restrictions:

 1. Builders (and most other workers) unlock certain tool levels per their hut level:
   lvl 0. Wood/Gold Tools
   lvl 1. Stone Tools
   lvl 2. Iron Tools
   lvl 3. Diamond Tools
   lvl 4-5. Enchanted Tools

 2. Builders have a maximum range of 100 blocks for buildings for automatic assignment. If your building is outside that range, in the top right of the build options GUI (for the hut you want to be built) you can select which Builder to assign to that building.
com.minecolonies.coremod.info.builder.2:
Now let's cover some frequently asked questions:

 Q 1. I'm seeing an item in the required resources page that seems unobtainable or requires Silk Touch to get. What should I do?
   A 1. Things like Air, Dirt Paths, and other blocks will show up in the required resources tab from time to time. While they do show up, focus mainly on your Builder's personal request tab. They'll usually request the correct block and convert it accordingly (e.g. request dirt and then use a shovel on it).
com.minecolonies.coremod.info.builder.3:
As all workers do, the Builder levels up while working.
 At higher levels, the Builder's speed increases. The higher their hut level and Intelligence skill, the quicker they level up. 
 However, their level is capped by the level of their home. Thus, if they are unhappy with their living conditions, they will stop leveling until you provide them with better housing.
com.minecolonies.coremod.info.citizen.0: The House is where your citizens will live. For every level of the House, the building will house one citizen. You will need multiple houses to house everyone. The only citizens that will not live in a House are your Guards.
com.minecolonies.coremod.info.citizen.1: In order to have children, a male and a female citizen must be housed together in one House. Even if you don't have room in the same hut as them, as long as there is an open bed in any House or Tavern within the colony, a child can be born. If there is an adult in another house, the child will be adopted by them, taking on the last name of that adult. If there is a hut with no adult in it, the child will get a random name.
com.minecolonies.coremod.info.citizen.2: Workers have their level capped by the level of their House. Thus, if they are unhappy with their living conditions, they will stop leveling until you provide them with better housing.
com.minecolonies.coremod.info.miner.0: The Miner is one of the production workers for your colony. They will need a pickaxe to mine stone, a shovel to mine dirt and gravel, and sometimes even an axe if they run into a mineshaft. They will also need supplies to build their own mineshafts, such as blocks, slabs, fences/walls, signs, ladders, and torches.
com.minecolonies.coremod.info.miner.1:
Let's cover restrictions:

 1. Miners unlock certain tool levels per their hut level:
   lvl 0. Wood/Gold Tools
   lvl 1. Stone Tools
   lvl 2. Iron Tools
   lvl 3. Diamond Tools
   lvl 4-5. Enchanted Tools
com.minecolonies.coremod.info.miner.2:
Now let's cover some frequently asked questions:

 Q 1. How far down will my miner dig before making nodes?
   A 1. Without intervention, at level 1 they will build nodes after they hit y level 50, at level 2 they will make nodes after they hit y level 30, and at level 3 they will make nodes after they hit y level 5.
com.minecolonies.coremod.info.miner.3:
Q2. My Miner just stops working or wanders around above ground, why?
  A 2. Either something is blocking their path or they don't have the necessary materials. See page 1 for the materials they need or check the Miner's request page.
com.minecolonies.coremod.info.miner.4:
As all workers do, Miners level up while working.
 At higher levels, the Miner's speed increases. The higher their hut level and Intelligence skill, the quicker they level up. 
 However, their level is capped by the level of their home. Thus, if they are unhappy with their living conditions, they will stop leveling until you provide them with better housing.
com.minecolonies.coremod.info.lumberjack:
The Forester is one of the production workers for your colony. Give them an axe and they'll cut down any trees around them. They'll also replant a sapling where the tree was if he has any.
 If you wish to apply restrictions on what trees they can or can't cut, take a look at the second page.
 Even cooler is the third page. Here you can tell the Forester to not replant saplings and tell them to be restricted to a certain 3D box (selected with the tool given by the third button on the page).

Now let's cover restrictions:

 1. Foresters unlock certain tool levels per their hut level:
   lvl 0. Wood/Gold Tools
   lvl 1. Stone Tools
   lvl 2. Iron Tools
   lvl 3. Diamond Tools
   lvl 4-5. Enchanted Tools

 2. Foresters are able to search for trees within 150 blocks of them (not their hut). While searching, they start with a 50 block range and then increase that range by 5 if they do not find a tree.

3. The definition of a "Tree" in Minecraft is pretty hazy at best. We've done our best to define a tree, but in some cases it may not be enough. Generally, we define a tree as a log and leaves next to each other. Due to this, some of your huts or decorations may be affected by the Forester. To counter this, you can place a piece of cobblestone below a log to mark it as "not a tree".

As all workers do, Foresters level up while working.
 At higher levels, the Forester's speed increases. The higher their hut level and Intelligence skill, the quicker they level up. 
 However, their level is capped by the level of their home. Thus, if they are unhappy with their living conditions, they will stop leveling until you provide them with better housing.
The Warehouse is part of colony management. It's where all of your excess supplies are stored. There are no workers assigned to the Warehouse, but Couriers use the Warehouse.

Let's cover restrictions:

 1. Space is limited to the number of racks in the schematic and you can not add your own. If you do, they will get destroyed when the building is updated and the Couriers will not see/use those racks. You also cannot move the racks already in the building. If you break a rack, it is no longer seen by the Couriers.

3. Now let's cover some frequently asked questions: 

 Q 1. I need more storage space that is given, how do I get more? 
 A 1. Upgrade the building. If the building is level 5, you can increase the space in each rack by buying more on page 2 of the GUI using an emerald block. This can be done 3 times.

Q 2. I want to move my Warehouse, can I do that? 
 A 2. You can, but if there is anything in the racks, the contents will spill out when the racks are removed by the Builder. If you must move the Warehouse, remove all the contents from the racks first, and watch to make sure any Couriers don't deliver items.
com.minecolonies.coremod.info.deliveryma: Couriers are part of colony management. They are the transportation service of the colony and will pick up unneeded items from worker huts and drop them at the Warehouse, as well as gather needed items from the Warehouse and deliver them to workers.

Now let's cover restrictions:

 The number of stacks a Courier can carry at a time depends on their hut level. 
 Level 1: 1 Stack 
 Level 2: 2 Stacks 
 Level 3: 4 Stacks 
 Level 4: 8 Stacks 
 Level 5: unlimited stacks (that can still fit in their inventory)

Now let's cover some frequently asked questions:

 Q 1. How do I change the priority of who the Couriers pick up from?
   A 1. In each hut, there is a pickup priority setting. 1 is the lowest, 10 is the highest, and there's also never (no items will ever be picked up).

 Q 2. Can I change the delivery priority?
 A 2. No, the delivery schedule is determined by the order the request is sent.

As all workers do, Couriers level up while working.
 At higher levels, a Courier's speed increases. The higher their hut level and Intelligence skill, the quicker they level up. 
 However, their level is capped by the level of their home. Thus, if they are unhappy with their living conditions, they will stop leveling until you provide them with better housing.
com.minecolonies.coremod.info.cook.0:
The Cook is part of the food production of your colony. The Cook supplies all your citizens with food and will cook meat and potatoes, as well as other cooked food that only needs a furnace.
 When a citizen gets hungry, they will go to the Cook to get something to eat.
com.minecolonies.coremod.info.cook.1:
Now let's cover some frequently asked questions:

 Q 1. The Cook is asking for items that are already cooked, is this normal?
   A 1. You can provide pre-cooked items for the Cook to distribute to your colonists.
com.minecolonies.coremod.info.cook.2:
As all workers do, the Cook levels up while working.
 At higher levels, a Cook's speed increases. The higher their hut level and Intelligence skill, the quicker they level up. 
 However, their level is capped by the level of their home. Thus, if they are unhappy with their living conditions, they will stop leveling until you provide them with better housing.
com.minecolonies.coremod.info.baker.0: The Baker is part of the food production of your colony. They will bake bread, cookies, pumpkin pie, and/or cake. On page two of the Bakery GUI, you can select which items you want them to make.
com.minecolonies.coremod.info.baker.1: The Baker cannot make any food with items that are not consumed in the making like pots and pans. These are usually from mods like Pam's.
com.minecolonies.coremod.info.baker.2:
Now let's cover some frequently asked questions:

 Q 1. My Baker is using more items than they are producing, why?
   A 1. The Baker may be consuming some product when they get hungry. Also, while the wheat/other ingredients may not be visible, the product may still be in the process of being produced.
com.minecolonies.coremod.info.baker.3:
As all workers do, the Baker levels up while working.
 At higher levels, a Baker's speed increases. The higher their hut level and Intelligence skill, the quicker they level up. 
 However, their level is capped by the level of their home. Thus, if they are unhappy with their living conditions, they will stop leveling until you provide them with better housing.
com.minecolonies.coremod.info.farmer.0: The Farmer is part of the food production of your colony. The Farmer grows crops for the colony. The Farmer can plant and harvest any crop that is planted in farmland, even from other mods.
com.minecolonies.coremod.info.farmer.1:
Farmers unlock certain tool levels per their hut level:
   lvl 0. Wood/Gold Tools
   lvl 1. Stone Tools
   lvl 2. Iron Tools
   lvl 3. Diamond Tools
   lvl 4-5. Enchanted Tools

 2. Farmers cannot grow plants that do not use farmland, such as sugar cane, cactus, or bamboo. These are grown by the Planter instead.
 Farmers can only maintain one field per each hut level.
com.minecolonies.coremod.info.farmer.2:
Now let's cover some frequently asked questions:

 Q 1. I want a smaller field, how do I tell my Farmer not to grow crops up to the maximum size? 
   A 1. Use the Field GUI to set the size of the field.
com.minecolonies.coremod.info.farmer.3:
As all workers do, the Farmer levels up while working.
 At higher levels, a Farmer's speed increases. The higher their hut level and Intelligence skill, the quicker they level up. 
 However, their level is capped by the level of their home. Thus, if they are unhappy with their living conditions, they will stop leveling until you provide them with better housing.
The Fisher is part of the food production of your colony. Simply put, the Fisher will fish as long as you provide them with a fishing rod and a big enough area of water.

Now let's cover restrictions:

 1. The Fisher needs a body of water at least seven blocks by seven blocks and at least one block deep. The hut block must be at the same level as the water and must be <= ten blocks from the water.

Now let's cover some frequently asked questions:

 Q 1. My Fisher is catching more than just fish, why?
   A 1. The Fishermen can catch other items, same as a player can.

As all workers do, the Fisher levels up while working.
 At higher levels, a Fisher's speed increases. The higher their hut level and Intelligence skill, the quicker they level up. 
 However, their level is capped by the level of their home. Thus, if they are unhappy with their living conditions, they will stop leveling until you provide them with better housing.
com.minecolonies.coremod.info.chickenher: The Chicken Farmer is part of the food production of your colony. The Chicken Farmer breeds, raises, and butchers chickens. They will collect eggs, feathers, and meat, as well as any drops from other mods. The Chicken Farmer will keep two chickens alive per level of their hut.

Now let's cover restrictions:

 1. Chicken Farmers unlock certain tool levels per their hut level:
   lvl 0. Wood/Gold Tools
   lvl 1. Stone Tools
   lvl 2. Iron Tools
   lvl 3. Diamond Tools
   lvl 4-5. Enchanted Tools

 2. At least two chickens must be provided for the Chicken Farmer to start breeding and butchering.

Now let's cover some frequently asked questions:

 Q 1. What does my Chicken Farmer need to work?
   A 1. You need to supply at least two chickens to get things started. The Chicken Farmer also needs seeds to breed the chickens and an axe to butcher them.

As all workers do, the Chicken Farmer levels up while working.
 At higher levels, a Chicken Farmer's speed increases. The higher their hut level and Intelligence skill, the quicker they level up. 
 However, their level is capped by the level of their home. Thus, if they are unhappy with their living conditions, they will stop leveling until you provide them with better housing.
com.minecolonies.coremod.info.swineherde: The Swineherd is part of the food production of your colony. The Swineherd breeds, raises, and butchers pigs. They will collect the meat, as well as any drops from other mods. The Swineherd will keep two pigs alive per level of their hut.

Now let's cover restrictions:

 1. Swineherds unlock certain tool levels per their hut level:
   lvl 0. Wood/Gold Tools
   lvl 1. Stone Tools
   lvl 2. Iron Tools
   lvl 3. Diamond Tools
   lvl 4-5. Enchanted Tools

 2. At least two pigs must be provided for the Swineherd to start breeding and butchering.

Now let's cover some frequently asked questions:

 Q 1. What does my Swineherd need to work?
   A 1. You need to supply at least two pigs to get things started. The Swineherd also needs carrots to breed the pigs and an axe to butcher them.

As all workers do, the Swineherd levels up while working.
 At higher levels, a Swineherd's speed increases. The higher their hut level and Intelligence skill, the quicker they level up. 
 However, their level is capped by the level of their home. Thus, if they are unhappy with their living conditions, they will stop leveling until you provide them with better housing.
com.minecolonies.coremod.info.shepherd.0: The Shepherd is part of the food production of your colony. The Shepherd breeds, raises, shears, and butchers sheep. They will collect the meat and wool, as well as any drops from other mods. The Shepherd will keep two sheep alive per level of their hut. If you choose, on the second page of the GUI you can tell the Shepherd to randomly dye sheep to get colored wool.
com.minecolonies.coremod.info.shepherd.1:

 1. Shepherds unlock certain tool levels per their hut level:
   lvl 0. Wood/Gold Tools
   lvl 1. Stone Tools

   lvl 3. Diamond Tools
   lvl 4-5. Enchanted Tools

 2. At least two sheep must be provided for the Shepherd to start breeding and butchering.
com.minecolonies.coremod.info.shepherd.2:
Now let's cover some frequently asked questions:

 Q 1. What does my Shepherd need to work?
   A 1. You need to supply at least two sheep to get things started. The Shepherd also needs wheat to breed the sheep, shears to shear the wool, and an axe to butcher the sheep.
com.minecolonies.coremod.info.shepherd.3:
As all workers do, the Shepherd levels up while working.
 At higher levels, a Shepherd's speed increases. The higher their hut level and Intelligence skill, the quicker they level up. 
 However, their level is capped by the level of their home. Thus, if they are unhappy with their living conditions, they will stop leveling until you provide them with better housing.
com.minecolonies.coremod.info.cowboy.0: The Cowhand is part of the food production of your colony. The Cowhand breeds, raises, and butchers cows. They will collect the meat and leather, as well as any drops from other mods. The Cowhand will keep two cows alive per level of their hut.
com.minecolonies.coremod.info.cowboy.1:

   lvl 1. Stone Tools

   lvl 4-5. Enchanted Tools

 2. At least two cows must be provided for the Cowhand to start breeding and butchering.
com.minecolonies.coremod.info.cowboy.2:

 Q 1. What does my Cowhand need to work?
   A 1. You need to supply at least two cows to get things started. The Cowhand also needs wheat to breed the cows and an axe to butcher them.
com.minecolonies.coremod.info.cowboy.3:

 At higher levels, a Cowhand's speed increases. The higher their hut level and Intelligence skill, the quicker they level up. 
 However, their level is capped by the level of their home. Thus, if they are unhappy with their living conditions, they will stop leveling until you provide them with better housing.
The Composter is part of the crafting line of your colony. The Composter will turn items into compost for Farmers and Florists to use.

Now let's cover restrictions:

 1. You must choose which items you want the Composter to use to make compost with. This is found on page two of the hut GUI. 
   Be careful using food items if you have a large colony but not many food production huts!

Now let's cover some frequently asked questions:

 Q 1. Can I use items from other mods?
   A 1. Yes, but these must be added in the MineColonies configuration file. This is found in (your instance folder)/config/minecolonies-common.toml.

As all workers do, the Composter levels up while working.
 At higher levels, a Composter's speed increases. The higher their hut level and Intelligence skill, the quicker they level up. 
 However, their level is capped by the level of their home. Thus, if they are unhappy with their living conditions, they will stop leveling until you provide them with better housing.
com.minecolonies.coremod.info.guardtower:
The Guard Tower is the basic hut for your military defense. Each Guard Tower employs one Guard. However, the Guard will also live in the tower, freeing up a bed for more citizens.
There are two different types of Guards, Knights and Archers. Knights use swords, while Archers use bows.

Now let's cover restrictions:

 1. Guards unlock certain tool levels per their hut level:
   lvl 0. Wood/Gold Tools
   lvl 1. Stone Tools
   lvl 2. Iron Tools
   lvl 3. Diamond Tools
   lvl 4-5. Enchanted Tools

Now let's cover some frequently asked questions:

 Q 1. My Guard Tower was leveled up, but the Guard isn't asking for higher-level equipment. Why?
   A 1. Guards will not ask for updated equipment until they use up their current equipment.

As all workers do, the Guard levels up while working.
 At higher levels, a Guard's speed increases. The higher their hut level and Intelligence skill, the quicker they level up. 
 However, their level is capped by the level of their home. Thus, if they are unhappy with their living conditions, they will stop leveling until you provide them with better housing.
com.minecolonies.coremod.info.barracksto:
The Barracks Tower is the heart of your military defense. Each Barracks Tower employs 1 Guard per level for a total of 5. However, the Guards will also live in the tower, freeing up beds for more citizens.
There are two different types of Guards, Knights and Archers. Knights use swords, while Archers use bows.

Now let's cover restrictions:

 1. Guards unlock certain tool levels per their hut level:
   lvl 0. Wood/Gold Tools
   lvl 1. Stone Tools
   lvl 2. Iron Tools
   lvl 3. Diamond Tools
   lvl 4-5. Enchanted Tools

Now let's cover some frequently asked questions:

 Q 1. My Barracks Tower was leveled up, but the Guards aren't asking for higher level equipment. Why?
   A 1. Guards will not ask for updated equipment until they use up their current equipment.

 At higher levels, a Guard's speed increases. The higher their hut level and Intelligence skill, the quicker they level up. 
 However, their level is capped by the level of their home. Thus, if they are unhappy with their living conditions, they will stop leveling until you provide them with better housing.
com.minecolonies.coremod.info.barracks.0:
The Barracks is the heart of your military defense. Without it you wouldn't be able to build any Barracks Towers!
 Each Barracks contains four Barracks Towers, one for each level (up to level four).
com.minecolonies.coremod.info.barracks.1:
Now let's cover restrictions:

 1. Barracks only hold 1 Barracks Tower per level, and each tower can only level as high as the Barracks. So if you have a level 1 Barracks, it will only allow 1 Barracks Tower with a max level of 1. If you have a level 3 Barracks, it will allow 3 Barracks Towers with a max level of 3.
com.minecolonies.coremod.info.barracks.2:
Now let's cover some frequently asked questions:

 Q 1. Can I have more than 1 Barracks?
   A 1. Yes, but the Barracks Tower levels are based on the Barracks they are attached to. So even if you have one Barracks that is level 5, if the second Barracks is only level 1, then that Barracks can only have a single level 1 tower.
The Graveyard is the resting place of your fallen citizens!

Without it, you'll still be able to manually collect fallen citizens' graves, but your colony will mourn longer.

Each Graveyard needs an Undertaker, who collects graves within the city.

During their free time, the Undertaker will get to know citizens and visit the Mystical Site, slowly attuning to the mana of the world.

If their Mana skill is high, the Undertaker has a small chance to resurrect a fallen citizen!

You can increase this chance by upgrading the Graveyard, building a Mystical Site, and completing researches in the University.

com.minecolonies.coremod.jei.sawmill: Crafts most things that are made primarily from wood.

com.minecolonies.coremod.jei.smelter: Breaks ore blocks with fortune (based on level), and smelts as needed.
com.minecolonies.coremod.jei.stonemason: Crafts things made from various kinds of stone.
com.minecolonies.coremod.jei.stonesmelte: Smelts various kinds of stone and terracotta.
com.minecolonies.coremod.jei.swineherder: Just happy with pigs in mud.
com.minecolonies.coremod.jei.netherworke: Makes periodic trips to the nether to retrieve materials, but it's a very dangerous job, and requires significant supplies.

minecolonies.quests.general.hungrycourie: Hey there, could I ask you a favour?
I'm starving and I forgot my lunch at home. Could you bring me some food?
What kind of food do you want?
A baked potato would just hit the spot!
Got it. I'll be right back.
I'm sorry, I don't have any food on me.
Ah, too bad. I guess I'll just have to make do until I get home.
I'll see if I can find something for you later.
Sorry, I'm in a rush right now!
Oh, this was great! Thanks a lot!
minecolonies.quests.general.thezombiemen: We have a problem. The Zombies in the nearby forest are causing trouble. Can you help us take care of them?
Sure, I'll do what I can.
Thank you! We need you to kill 10 Zombies. We'll reward you for your efforts.
I'm sorry, I can't help right now.
You did it! We're safe for now. Here's your reward.
minecolonies.quests.guides.buildergoggle: Hey there! Can I ask you for a favor? I lost my glasses the other day and I can't see very well without them. Do you think you could get me a new pair of builders goggles?
Of course, I'll see what I can do!
Sorry, I don't have time to help you right now.
I already know all about the builder goggles. You'll be fine without them!
Ah, you found my glasses! Thank you so much. I can finally see clearly what I'm building again. You should try them out sometime, they're pretty neat.
minecolonies.quests.guides.clipboard.obj: Sure, I'll see what I can do!
Sorry, I can't help you right now.
I already know what it does!

Great, you found a clipboard! To use it, simply shift-right click it on any hut block. This will give you an overview of all the requests in the colony. It's super handy, and I am so grateful that you were able to get one for me. Thank you!
minecolonies.quests.guides.rallybanner.o: Lately, we've been seeing a lot of skeletons wandering around at night. If you could help us out by taking care of ten of them, we'd be very grateful!
No problem, I'll take care of it!
Sorry, I'm too busy right now.
Sorry, I don't think I can help you with that.
Thank you for taking care of those skeletons! You're very brave. Listen, I have something that might help us out. It's called a rallying banner. Could you bring it to me?
Sorry, I don't think I can help you with that.
A rallying banner? Sounds interesting. I'll go find it.

Thanks for bringing me the rallying banner! To use it, simply shift-right click it on any hut block. This will allow you to assign guards to it, and you can manage it by right clicking in the air. It's a great tool for keeping the colony safe!
Great, I'll make sure to put it to good use!
minecolonies.quests.guides.resourcescrol: Hello there! Have you heard about the Resource Scroll? It's a powerful tool that can help you gather resources more efficiently. I really need one, but I don't have the time to go and find it myself. Would you be willing to bring one to me?
Sure, I can try to find one for you!
I'm sorry, I don't have the time right now.
I already know what it does!

Thank you so much for bringing me the Resource Scroll! You know, all you have to do is shift-right-click it on the hut block to activate it. It will help you gather resources more quickly and efficiently. I hope you find it as useful as I do!
Thanks for the tip, I'll be sure to use it!
minecolonies.quests.romance.aromanticges: Hello there, could I ask you to help me with something?
I want to give a poppy to $1, but I'm too shy to do it myself. Can you deliver it for me?
Of course, I'll be happy to help.
I'm sorry, but I can't do that for you.
Oh, that's too bad. I guess I'll have to try to do it myself.
I'm sorry, I don't have time right now.
Oh, this is beautiful! Thank you so much! Who is it from?
Oh, I see! I'll be sure to thank them. Here, take this as a token of my gratitude.
Hey, thank you so much for delivering that poppy to me earlier. It really made my day. I was wondering if I could ask you for another favour?
Of course, what do you need?
I have a friend who is feeling a bit down and I want to cheer them up. Could you bring $1 this gift for me?
Sure, I'll be happy to help.
I'm sorry, but I'm a bit busy right now.
Oh, that's too bad. Maybe another time then.
Sure, I'll keep it in mind.
I'm sorry, but I can't help you right now.
Oh, hello! $0 told me to bring you a gift to cheer you up.
How kind of them! Thank you so much!
Thank you so much for delivering that gift. You're a true friend.
No problem, glad I could help.

info.gateways.gate_pearl:
A Gate Pearl allows you to summon a Gateway by using it on a block.

There will need to be sufficient space available, and another Gateway cannot already be open.
info.gateways.gate_pearl.2:
An open Gateway will fail in a burst of lightning if it cannot spawn a mob, any active mob walks too far away, or the wave timer elapses.

Rewards will spawn from the Gateway as they are obtained.

toomanyglyphs.glyph_desc.glyph_lay_on_ha: A context-sensitive blend of Touch and Self. toomanyglyphs.glyph_desc.glyph_ray: Instantaneously strikes the pointed-at target, at limited yet greater range than Touch. Mana is expended whether or not the ray hits anything. AOE increases range. ars_additions.category.structures.desc: Structures that can be found around your world to sprinkle in a little extra magic.
ars_additions.glyph_desc.glyph_mark: Marks the target and stores the mark in a Reliquary.
ars_additions.glyph_desc.glyph_recall: Recalls the target stored in a Reliquary and casts the spell on it.
ars_additions.glyph_desc.glyph_retaliate: Applies spells to the last entity that dealt damage to you. The damage must be within the last 5 seconds.
ars_additions.page.ender_source_jar: The Ender Source Jar allows you to store source in an ender-connected Source Jar. Each jar you place will link to the same pool of source, allowing you to use the Source Jar from anywhere.
ars_additions.page.unstable_reliquary: Reliquaries are able to store references to entities and locations to be targeted using the Recall glyph. To store a reference in a Reliquary, hold it in your off-hand and cast a spell with the Mark glyph.
ars_additions.page1.ruined_warp_portals: Ruined Warp Portals can be found scattered around the world, displaying an Ancient Warp Portal that has degraded over time. Accompanying these portals is a chest containing an Explorer's Warp Scroll. This scroll remains heavily imbued with magic after all these years and can activate the repaired portal with no additional source required.
ars_additions.page1.warp_indexes: Warp Indexes are used to remotely access your Storage Lecterns. The Warp Index allows you to access your Storage Lectern anywhere within the same dimension. The Stabilized Warp Index does not have the same limitation and will work in any dimension. Both of these Warp Indexes require your Storage Lectern to be chunk-loaded.
ars_additions.ritual_desc.ritual_chunk_l: The Ritual of Arcane Permanence force-loads surrounding chunks when provided with a constant stream of source.
ars_nouveau.page1.wilden_dens: Wilden Dens can be found in forests far away from civilization. These Wilden Dens house the fearsome Wilden which you will need to defeat in order to harness their magic.

ars_elemental.page.elemental_tweaks: As long as Ars Elemental is installed, these tweaks will be active:$(br)Enchanter's Shield can trigger reactive on block.$(br)Summoned Lightnings won't destroy items.$(br)Crush can process items if augmented with Sensitive.$(br)Cold Snap deals more damage to mobs that are freezing.$(br)Ignite melts ice blocks into water.
ars_elemental.page1.flashing_archwood: This golden tree has an affinity with the sky. Just like the other archwood trees it can be found anywhere and in their biome. It can be used to make ritual tablets or as a dim light source. The corresponding Weald Walker launches enemies in the air and wind shear them.
ars_elemental.page2.flashing_archwood: A fruit with a shocking flavour used to brew Static Charge Potions, causing a lightning to fall on the entity when the duration ends or allowing Discharge to hit. The energy stored in the fruit may cause whoever eats it to glow, get night vision, be shocked or charged with static energy.
ars_elemental.page1.spell_horn: The Enchanter's Horn can be used to cast spells on you and nearby entities. Hold the Horn to increase the range, at max charge it will also give a Spell Damage effect to the player. It MUST be inscribed with a spell that does NOT have another method, using a Scribing Table.
ars_elemental.page.curio_bag: All those trinkets can easily clutter your inventory, but you never know when they will be useful. Using some magebloom fiber you can make a pouch to store and carry around curios, potion flasks, charms and other small items. You can also open it with $(k:ars_elemental.open_pouch) while in the hotbar or in a curio slot.
ars_elemental.page.caster_bag: The trinket pouch can only hold rather small things, but with a stronger fiber it seems possible to hold different kind of magical items. The Spellcaster bag can hold any caster tool and the mod's magic armor, arrow and shield. You can also open it with $(k:ars_elemental.open_pouch) while in the hotbar or in a curio slot.
ars_elemental.page1.fire_focus: This spell focus is attuned to the school of Fire. While equipped, the glyphs of this school will be amplified and discounted. The lesser focus, as a drawback, will weaken glyphs of the other elemental schools. The major focus will also grant Spell Damage II while the wearer is on fire or in lava.
ars_elemental.page2.fire_focus: This focus empowers Ignite to inflict Hellfire Burn. This effect reduces healing and allows flare to inflict damage and spread even on fire resistant mobs. Summon Steed will be changed to summon a rideable Strider. Ignite + Evaporate combo will sublimate Ice.
ars_elemental.page1.water_focus: This spell focus is attuned to the school of Water. While equipped, the glyphs of this school will be amplified and discounted. The lesser focus, as a drawback, will weaken glyphs of the other elemental schools. The major focus will also grant Mana Regen I while the wearer is wet or Mana Regen II and Dolphin Grace while swimming.
ars_elemental.page2.water_focus: This focus empowers Freeze, adding Freezing seconds to the target. If used after Conjure Water, the conjured water will become ice. Summon Steed will be changed to summon a rideable Dolphin, time your jumps out of the water to build up speed. All Drowning damage against water creatures will be converted to magic.
ars_elemental.page1.air_focus: This spell focus is attuned to the school of Air. While equipped, the glyphs of this school will be amplified and discounted. The lesser focus, as a drawback, will weaken glyphs of the other elemental schools. The major focus will also grant Mana Regen I while the wearer stands over Y 200 or is under the shocked effect.
ars_elemental.page2.air_focus: This focus empowers Launch, changing it to apply Levitate when augmented with ExtendTime. It also empower Cut, giving chances to drop an head or skull if it deals the killing blow.
ars_elemental.page1.earth_focus: This spell focus is attuned to the school of Earth. While equipped, the glyphs of this school will be amplified and discounted. The lesser focus, as a drawback, will weaken glyphs of the other elemental schools. The major focus also grants Mana Regen I while the wearer stand under Y 0.
ars_elemental.page2.earth_focus: This focus empowers Poison Spores and Grow, dealing damage to undead with a chance of spawning a spore blossom, and Gravity, when augmented with Sensitive, changing it to create a gravity field that pull entities towards its center (filter-compatible), also offers knockback resistance and boosts natural and instant healing by 1.5.
ars_elemental.page1.necrotic_focus: This school of magic branched out from Conjuration and Abjuration mages that tried to understand life, death and what's between. The essence tied to this school cycles between life and death, experiments suggest that it will make horses cycle between flesh, skeleton and zombie forms, but will it be the same horse as before?
ars_elemental.page2.necrotic_focus: By imbuing the Focus of Summoning with evil energies, you can corrupt its powers towards Necromancy. Glyphs of the Anima school will get two free ExtendTime, Heal gets two amplify and Charm has way more chance to affect undead mobs. Summon Steed will change in Summon Skeletal Steed, which is able to walk and breathe underwater.
ars_elemental.page3.necrotic_focus: Summoned Wolves, Undead and Vexes seems unchanged at first, but if they die while the summoner wear this focus they will rise from death once, filled with blood lust. These undead summons will cast Homing spells when you do and heal you every time they kill an enemy.
ars_elemental.page.water_upstream: This block generates an upstream current that will make surrounding entities in water float upwards as if inside a bubble column, even if they are not in source blocks. Sneaking will allow to descend.
ars_elemental.page.magma_upstream: This block generates an upstream current that will make surrounding entities in lava float upwards and gain a short Fire Resistance effect. Sneaking will allow to descend
ars_elemental.page.air_upstream: This block generates an upstream current that will make surrounding entities levitate. Sneaking will give Slowfall and allow to descend. Consumes Source when at least an entity is affected.
ars_elemental.page.everfull_urn: This magic urn converts Source into water. Link a cauldron or an Apothecary to the urn using a dominion wand and it will be refilled for a cheap amount of source.
ars_elemental.page1.fire_golem: The Flarecannon can be used as a wandering sentry, like the weald walkers. It will shoot flare homing projectiles at enemies and patrol around the area assigned using the dominion wand. Soul Sand and Magma blocks can be used to change appearance. If defeated, it can be reactivated with blaze powder or magma cream. Friends call it Firenando.
ars_elemental.page1.mermaid: Sirens are found in warmer seas, jumping out of the water or following boats. You can befriend a wild mermaid by giving them a sea pickle, they will jump and leave behind few shards. The siren charm can be used to summon a Siren and if used on Prismarine it will transform in a Siren Shrine. Tamed sirens can change colors if you give them kelp or corals.
ars_elemental.page2.mermaid: The Shrine will slowly generate fishing loot items over time, asking for source after each cycle. The number of items and chance of getting a treasure will increase if many different water animals and plants are near the Shrine. You should build an aquarium or pond around the Shrine, to let your sirens have fun. [Note: it will take some time to update the score].
ars_elemental.page1.advanced_prism: Upgrade of the Spell Prism that can be adjusted to aim to a specific block. Use the dominion wand to link the prism to a block. This prism also allows lenses, but can't be pushed by pistons.
ars_elemental.page2.advanced_prism: A Prism Lens can be applied to this advanced prisms to customize how the prism redirects projectiles. Arc and Homing lenses change the projectile to be an arc or homing projectile. Rainbow lens randomize the color of the projectile, while Acceleration and Deceleration lenses allow to adjust the speed.
ars_elemental.page.spell_mirror: Mirror similar to a Spell Prism that can be placed on walls, floor and ceiling. If a spell projectile hits the mirror, it will be reflected by with a mirrored angle.
ars_elemental.page1.elemental_turrets: Enchanted Turrets can be imbued with the power of an elemental focus to gift them a fractions of its abilities. Spells shot by these turrets will trigger the combos of the corresponding focus and will be discounted by 65 %% if the spell contains a glyph of the matching elemental school.
ars_elemental.page.base_bangle: This magic accessory has a chance to boost the damage of your spells. Its magic is unstable but perhaps attuning it to a school can stabilize its abilities.
ars_elemental.page1.air_bangle: This bangle will boost the damage of your Air spells. Your arms sparks with the element, giving a passive boost to speed and attack knockback.
ars_elemental.page1.fire_bangle: This bangle will boost the damage of your Fire spells. Your arms are engulfed in the element, setting on fire enemies hit and granting a passive boost to speed while in hot biomes.
ars_elemental.page1.earth_bangle: This bangle will boost the damage of your Earth spells. Plants blossom on your arms, inflicting snare to enemies hit and granting the wearer immunity to cactus and berry bushes and knockback resistance.
ars_elemental.page1.water_bangle: This bangle will boost the damage of your Water spells. Your arms chills the air around, freezing enemies on every hit. It will also grant the wearer a passive boost to speed in water and rain.
ars_elemental.page.book_protection: This book upgrade will protect your spellbook from all kinds of damage, may it be a cactus or a pool of lava. Can't guarantee on the void. The gold inlays will become netherite-black but you can toggle it off in the client configs.
ars_elemental.perk_desc.thread_shock: Damaging effects cause the target to be shocked for a short duration before the effect resolves. Inflicts Static Charged at tier 3.
ars_elemental.perk_desc.thread_spore: Damaging effects cause the target to be poisoned or hungry for a short duration before the effect resolves.
ars_elemental.perk_desc.thread_summon: Reduce Summon Sickness by 10%% for each tier. Starting from tier 2, it also slightly increase damage dealt by summoned creatures.
ars_elemental.ritual_desc.ritual_squirre: Gives a long speed boost to Starbuncles in the area. Refresh buff every 30 seconds in a 15 cubes radius. Radius can be augmented to 30 with a gold block
ars_elemental.ritual_desc.ritual_tesla_c: Calls lightning on entities that approach the ritual area of effect. Will target players if augmented with Air Essence. [11x7x11 cube centered on the brazier].
ars_elemental.ritual_desc.ritual_repulsi: Repel all mobs in a 15 block radius. Can be augmented with a bone to repel only undead mobs. Won't work on player and bosses.
ars_elemental.ritual_desc.ritual_attract: Make the brazier act as a magnet for entities in a 8 blocks radius. Won't work on players and bosses.
ars_elemental.ritual_desc.ritual_detecti: Makes all monsters in a 128 blocks radius glow for 10 minutes.
ars_elemental.enchantment_desc.mirror_sh: Can only be applied on the Enchanter's Shield. Gives a chance of reflecting spell projectiles and warden sonic booms while blocking with the shield. 25% per level.
ars_elemental.enchantment_desc.soulbound: Prevent the item enchanted from being lost on death.
ars_elemental.familiar_desc.siren_famili: A Siren Familiar will increase the damage of Water spells by 2. It will also give Dolphin Grace II to the summoner while in water. Obtained by performing the Ritual of Binding near a Siren.
ars_elemental.familiar_desc.firenando_fa: A Flarecannon Familiar increases the damage of Fire spells by 2 and reduce projectile-based spells cost by 20%%. You can feed it a Magma Cream to get a short Fire Resistance buff. Obtained by performing the Ritual of Binding near a Flarecannon.
ars_elemental.glyph_desc.glyph_discharge: Discharge an entity affected by static charge or shocked, damaging it and shocking surrounding enemies. If the damage was triggered by static charge, it will be empowered. If the main target had energy-based armors, some of the energy in it will be absorbed to boost damage.
ars_elemental.glyph_desc.glyph_spark: Damages the target with a spark of static energy shocks it. Deals more damage to wet entities
ars_elemental.glyph_desc.glyph_bubble_sh: Creates a protective coating that consumes mana to reduce incoming damage. The shield might also prevent debuff to affect the entity and will dissipate if the mana exhausts while defending. May also cure from Hellfire burn if used with the water focus.
ars_elemental.glyph_desc.glyph_watery_gr: Dooms a creature to drown. Reduces the target air supply and causes drowning damage when depleted. Similar to gravity the target will sunken down if in water, can be augmented with ExtendTime.
ars_elemental.glyph_desc.glyph_conjure_t: Places Dirt or other terrain blocks. Can be augmented with AoE and Pierce to place more blocks, one Amplify to place cobblestone, two for cobbled deepslate, or one of the following combinations: Followed by ConjureWater, it will place Mud. If augmented with Amplify(s) and followed by Smelt, it will place Stone or Deepslate. If followed by Crush it will place Sand or, if amplified, Sandstone.
ars_elemental.glyph_desc.glyph_poison_sp: A fog of poison spores erupts from the target, damaging it and causing poison and hunger to spread to nearby entities. It can only damage mobs poisoned or afflicted by hunger.
ars_elemental.glyph_desc.glyph_phantom_g: Heals a small amount of health to undead. When used on living beings, the spell will deal an equal amount of magic and exhaustion damage, depleting their saturation or hunger.
ars_elemental.glyph_desc.glyph_spike: Creates a spike of dripstone that will damage entities that touch it. Can be augmented with AoE and Pierce to make it wider or taller, with ExtendTime to make it last longer or with Amplify to make it deal more damage.
ars_elemental.glyph_desc.glyph_envenom: Poisons the target, dealing damage over time. If the target is already poisoned, the poison will become a more deadly venom. An envenomed target takes more damage from poison spores.
ars_elemental.glyph_desc.glyph_homing_pr: This projectile seek the nearest entity and follow it, will behave as a classic projectile while there are no valid targets. Players will only be targeted if augmented by Sensitive.
ars_elemental.glyph_desc.glyph_propagato: Convert the remainder of the spell into an Homing Projectile and shoot it from where it lands.
ars_elemental.glyph_desc.glyph_curved_pr: This projectile is affected by gravity. Every Pierce applied will make it bounce one time when it hit the ground.
ars_elemental.glyph_desc.glyph_propagato: Convert the remainder of the spell into an Arc Projectile and shoot it from where it lands.
ars_elemental.glyph_desc.glyph_aquatic_f: Stops the spell from resolving unless it targets an aquatic creature.
ars_elemental.glyph_desc.glyph_not_aquat: Stops the spell from resolving if it targets an aquatic creature.
ars_elemental.glyph_desc.glyph_aerial_fi: Stops the spell from resolving unless it targets an aerial creature.
ars_elemental.glyph_desc.glyph_not_aeria: Stops the spell from resolving if it targets an aerial creature.
ars_elemental.glyph_desc.glyph_fiery_fil: Stops the spell from resolving unless it targets a fire immune or fiery creature.
ars_elemental.glyph_desc.glyph_not_fiery: Stops the spell from resolving if it targets a fire immune or fiery creature.
ars_elemental.glyph_desc.glyph_insect_fi: Stops the spell from resolving unless it targets an arthropod creature.
ars_elemental.glyph_desc.glyph_not_insec: Stops the spell from resolving if it targets an arthropod creature.
ars_elemental.glyph_desc.glyph_undead_fi: Stops the spell from resolving unless it targets an undead creature.
ars_elemental.glyph_desc.glyph_not_undea: Stops the spell from resolving if it targets an undead creature.
ars_elemental.glyph_desc.glyph_summon_fi: Stops the spell from resolving unless it targets a summoned creature.
ars_elemental.glyph_desc.glyph_not_summo: Stops the spell from resolving if it targets a summoned creature.
ars_elemental.glyph_desc.glyph_life_link: You create a link between your life force and the target's. Any damage dealt to you will be shared with the target and any healing of the target will be shared with you. Cut can sever the life link, ending the effect on both sides.
ars_elemental.glyph_desc.glyph_charm: Try to dominate the mind of enemy, making them fight for you as a temporary ally, a tamable mob, to tame it, or a wild animal, to make it fall in love. Each Amplify and damage dealt raises the chance of successfully charming the target, as stronger mobs will have higher resistance to your control.
death.attack.hellflare.item: %1$s was burned by %2$s with the magic flames of %3$s
ars_elemental.lens.arc: Convert the redirected projectile in an Arc Projectile.
ars_elemental.lens.homing: Convert the redirected projectile in an Homing Projectile. The targeting filters of the original projectile won't be inherited.
ars_elemental.lens.rgb: Makes the redirected projectile cycle colors.
ars_elemental.lens.acceleration: Increase the speed of the redirected projectile.
ars_elemental.lens.deceleration: Decrease the speed of the redirected projectile.
ars_elemental.lens.pierce: Makes the redirected projectile more piercing if source is supplied.
ars_elemental.page.armor_set.wip: Note: Since the Armor Rework requires a lot of assets work, the light and heavy elemental armors variants won't be ready for 1.19, so the 'medium' elemental armors can be crafted will all three types. Upgrading will keep enchants and threads, but requires the base armor to be at tier 3.
ars_elemental.armor_set.fire.desc: Absorb some fire-related damage and convert into mana, instantly clears fire.
ars_elemental.armor_set.aqua.desc: Absorb some water-related damage and convert into mana, refill air if about to drown.
ars_elemental.armor_set.earth.desc: Absorb some earth-related damage and convert into mana, gives food deep underground if about to starve.
ars_elemental.armor_set.air.desc: Absorb some air-related damage and convert into mana, highly reduce fall damage.
ars_elemental.page.armor_set.fire: Attuned to the School of Fire, each piece of this armor will amplify fire glyphs, make them cheaper, and reduce damage related to fire, like lava, dragon breath and magma.$(br)When all the pieces are equipped, the damage reduced is converted into mana and fire is immediately put out.
ars_elemental.page.armor_set.aqua: Attuned to the School of Water, each piece of this armor will amplify water glyphs, make them cheaper and reduce damage related to water, like drowning, freezing and lightning.$(br)When all the pieces are equipped, the damage reduced is converted into mana and refill air if about to drown.
ars_elemental.page.armor_set.air: Attuned to the School of Air, each piece of this armor will amplify air glyphs, make them cheaper and reduce damage related to air, like falling, hitting walls while flying and lightning.$(br)When all the pieces are equipped, the damage reduced is converted into mana, falling won't be a problem anymore!.
ars_elemental.page.armor_set.earth: Attuned to the School of Earth, each piece of this armor will amplify earth glyphs, make them cheaper and reduce damage related to earth, like starving, berry bushes, cactus and crushing.$(br)When all the pieces are equipped, the damage reduced is converted into mana and gives food deep underground if about to starve.
